articles.title: OpenTWBench (Open Taiwan Benchmark): Taiwan-Domain Knowledge Evaluation for Large Language Models, and How the Measurement Apparatus Shapes the Score
articles.abstract: We present OpenTWBench, an open evaluation suite for Taiwan-domain knowledge in large language models, built around two benchmarks. tw-exam-bench contains 255,854 four-option questions across 148 academic subjects, from fifteen years of Taiwan's national examinations published as open data by the Ministry of Examination; answer keys agree across 31,312 duplicated question groups at 99.91%, with all 27 disagreements accounted for. A reviewed second pass withdrew 2,180 items whose stems depend on a figure the text does not carry; all scores use the remaining 253,674. tw-formosa-bench contains 1,696 difficulty-curated questions about everyday and contemporary Taiwan - the Taiwan that licensing examinations never ask about - generated from a community-curated corpus under a discipline in which no model writes a ground truth, and curated against a frozen seven-model pool so that the pool scored at the passing margin (46.9-74.6%, median ~54%); a leave-one-out experiment shows the selection preserves model ranking (near-zero bias). Within six weeks the frontier had cleared that band: of 108 models now on the public board, 22 score above its ceiling, the best 91.6%. We also document how much of a score comes from the apparatus rather than the model. On identical questions, switching answer extraction from pattern matching to an explicit \boxed{} answer moves accuracy from 20.8% to 93.9%; a single placeholder character in a system prompt moved one model from last (58.2%) to first (83.9%) on the same benchmark; doubling the thinking budget from 8k to 16k tokens bought 0.2% while shuffling which questions failed; and a three-judge validation panel proved to be one judge in disguise, two members approving 92-99% of everything shown. We release all datasets, per-item difficulty data, curation manifests and a leaderboard at https://opentwbench.ai
articles.comment: 19 pages, no figures. Datasets, per-item difficulty data and a public leaderboard at https://opentwbench.ai
articles.titleCn: OpenTWBench（开放台湾基准）：针对大型语言模型的台湾领域知识评估，以及测量工具如何影响分数
articles.abstractCn: 我们介绍了OpenTWBench，这是一个针对台湾领域知识的开放评估套件，围绕两个基准构建。tw-exam-bench包含148个学术科目中来自台湾十五年国家考试（由考试院作为开放数据发布）的255,854个四选项问题，答案键在31,312个重复问题组中的一致性达到99.91%，所有27个不一致之处均已记录。经过审查的第二轮筛选撤回了2,180个项目，其题干依赖于文本未包含的图形；所有评分均使用剩余的253,674个项目。tw-formosa-bench包含1,696个关于日常和当代台湾的难度筛选问题——即执照考试从不询问的台湾——这些问题从社区维护的语料库中生成，该领域没有模型能写出真实标准，并且针对冻结的七模型池进行筛选，使得该池的得分处于及格边缘（46.9-74.6%，中位数约54%）；留一实验表明，选择保留了模型排名（偏差接近零）。六周内，前沿清除了该范围：在公共版块上的108个模型中，22个得分超过其上限，最佳得分为91.6%。我们还记录了得分中有多少来自工具而非模型。在相同问题上，将答案提取从模式匹配切换到显式的\boxed{}答案将准确率从20.8%提高到93.9%；系统提示中的一个占位符字符将一个模型在同一基准上的排名从最后（58.2%）提升到第一（83.9%）；将思考预算从8k增加到16k标记提升了0.2%，同时打乱了哪些问题失败；一个三法官验证小组被证明是一个伪装的法官，其中两名成员批准了92-99%的所有展示内容。我们发布了所有数据集、逐项难度数据、筛选说明和排行榜，网址为https://opentwbench.ai。

articles.title: EGCForest: Structured Agent Memory Organization for Enterprise Group Chats
articles.abstract: Enterprise group chats record project progress, decisions, task ownership, and other organizational information valuable to enterprise agents. Reliable retrieval is challenging because evidence spans interleaved threads, channels, and time, with meaning and authority conditioned on the speaker. Neither RAG's independent chunk retrieval nor memory systems' summary-based consolidation can reliably recover such distributed evidence. We present EGCForest, a novel multi-view hierarchical memory framework for enterprise group chats. EGCForest organizes an immutable message log into three complementary forests: a Channel forest for temporal workflows, an Actor forest for speaker-conditioned context, and an Artifact forest for deliverable lifecycles. Cross-view connections are enabled by a Placement Map and sparse structural bridges. Built on this memory backbone, EGCForest retrieves and assembles evidence by jointly leveraging message-level relevance, hierarchical context from forest summaries, and cross-view links, recovering distributed evidence. Experiments on three enterprise-chat benchmarks show that EGCForest consistently outperforms RAG and memory-system baselines, improving answer accuracy by up to 20.85 points over MemOS while supporting efficient online retrieval.
articles.titleCn: EGCForest：企业群聊的 结构化代理记忆组织
articles.abstractCn: 企业群聊记录项目进展、决策、任务归属等对企业代理具有重要价值的组织信息。由于证据跨越交织的线程、频道和时间，且意义和权限取决于发言者，可靠的检索极具挑战性。RAG的独立块检索和基于摘要的记忆系统整合都无法可靠地恢复此类分布式证据。我们提出了EGCForest，一个用于企业群聊的新型多视图层次记忆框架。EGCForest将不可变消息日志组织成三个互补的森林：用于时间工作流的频道森林、用于发言者条件化上下文的演员森林，以及用于交付物生命周期的工件森林。通过放置图和稀疏结构桥梁实现跨视图连接。基于此记忆骨干，EGCForest通过联合利用消息级相关性、森林摘要的层次上下文和跨视图链接来检索和组装证据，从而恢复分布式证据。在三个企业聊天气候基准测试中，EGCForest始终优于RAG和记忆系统基线，在MemOS上答案准确率提升高达20.85个百分点，同时支持高效的在线检索。

articles.title: MAPLE: A Multi-Axis Parametric Knowledge Extraction Lens for LLM Evaluation
articles.abstract: LLMs absorb vast knowledge from training data, yet their inherently probabilistic nature offers no guarantee that this knowledge will surface in their outputs. To bridge this gap, Knowledge Extraction Enhancement (KEE) techniques such as activation steering, decoding adjustments, and prompting modify inference, potentially reinforcing existing predictions or surfacing less accessible answers. Yet their evaluations centered on aggregate accuracy, which obscures diverse effects by collapsing recovered failures and disrupted successes into a single score. We introduce MAPLE, a unified framework for characterizing how KEE techniques affect parametric knowledge extraction. Its diagnostic metrics disentangle these effects at the surface, probability, and beyond-sampling levels by measuring answer recovery and disruption, gold-token rank shifts on unrecovered failures, and recovery of answers missed by fixed-budget sampling. We evaluate six KEE techniques spanning decoding, activation steering, and prompting across three model families: OLMo2, Qwen2.5, and Llama3. Our analysis reveals distinct effects and trade-offs across techniques, highlighting the value of MAPLE for understanding and comparing KEE beyond aggregate accuracy.
articles.titleCn: MAPLE：用于LLM评估的多轴参数化知识提取镜
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型从训练数据中吸收大量知识，但它们固有的概率性质并不能保证这些知识会在其输出中显现。为了弥补这一差距，知识提取增强（KEE）技术，如激活引导、解码调整和提示，通过修改推理过程来增强现有预测或揭示不太容易获取的答案。然而，它们的评估主要基于整体准确率，这会将恢复失败的案例和破坏成功的案例合并为一个单一分数，从而掩盖了多样化的影响。我们引入了MAPLE，这是一个统一的框架，用于描述KEE技术如何影响参数化知识提取。其诊断指标通过测量答案恢复和破坏、未恢复失败的黄金标记排名变化，以及固定预算采样遗漏的答案的恢复情况，在表面、概率和采样之外的水平上分离这些影响。我们在三个模型家族：OLMo2、Qwen2.5和Llama3上评估了六种KEE技术，涵盖解码、激活引导和提示。我们的分析揭示了不同技术之间的独特效果和权衡，突出了MAPLE在超越整体准确率理解和比较KEE方面的价值。

articles.title: Model vs. User: Whose Values Prevail? Inference-Time Value Alignment in Multi-Turn Conversations
articles.abstract: Human values shape how we expect language models to behave. Dominant alignment approaches treat values as global objectives, although the appropriate value orientation is personal and contextual. Training-free alignment can steer models toward target values at inference time, yet has been largely evaluated in single-turn settings and with a single steering direction (e.g., toward safety). We evaluate four prompt- and activation-based steering methods in multi-turn conversations, where user and assistant models push toward the same or opposing, equally desirable values. We track alignment with a linear probe across three models and two value trade-offs. When assistant and user pull in opposite directions, the side matching the assistant's baseline bias often prevails, and effects that look successful early often fade or reverse after a few turns. Steering should therefore be evaluated over full conversations and in both directions of a value trade-off.
articles.titleCn: 模型与用户：谁的价值观占上风？多轮对话中的推理时价值观对齐
articles.abstractCn: 人类价值观塑造了我们期望语言模型的行为方式。主流的校准方法将价值观视为全局目标，尽管适当的价值观取向是个人化和情境化的。无训练校准可以在推理时引导模型朝向目标价值观，但主要在单轮设置中，且仅以单一引导方向（例如，朝向安全）进行评估。我们在多轮对话中评估了四种基于提示和激活的引导方法，其中用户和助手模型朝向相同或相反、同等可取的价值观推动。我们通过在三个模型和两个价值观权衡中跟踪线性探针来评估校准效果。当助手和用户朝相反方向推动时，与助手基线偏见相匹配的一方往往占主导地位，而且早期看似成功的效果在几轮后往往会减弱或逆转。因此，引导效果应在完整对话中，以及在价值观权衡的两个方向上进行评估。

articles.title: Delta Tokenizer: Reference-Identical Tokenization of Session Deltas and Segment-Parallelism for Long Prompts on Multicore CPUs
articles.abstract: An agent that drives an LLM sends the model the same conversation again and again, and each turn adds only a little text at the end. Inference engines reuse the KV cache of the shared prefix, so only the new tokens pass through the model. However, tokenization has no such shortcut. The CPU front end of the serving engine converts every request back into token IDs from its first character, which lengthens the time to first token (TTFT) and consumes CPU on every turn. We present Delta Tokenizer, a CPU tokenization front end that tokenizes only the delta between a request and the previous request of the same session. It retains the earlier token sequence, encodes again only the appended text and the short tail whose tokens the append could affect, and joins the two only at a position the tokenizer's splitting rules themselves cannot move, which keeps the result exact. For long requests with no state to reuse, it cuts the text where practical tokenizers already keep neighboring pieces independent, encodes the pieces on several cores at once, and concatenates the outputs into the reference encoding, exactly. A shared CPU pool schedules these chunks together with the short incremental updates, so an update runs between two chunks rather than behind an entire long job. The incremental path shortens the tokenization of a session turn by roughly 40x relative to the Hugging Face reference tokenizer, and on 16 cores the chunk-parallel path encodes a four-million-character request 8.2x faster than a serial encode and 1.6-2.1x faster than LoPT. Inside SGLang, Delta Tokenizer reduces the median TTFT through the chat interface by 59% at 100K tokens and brings the P99 TTFT of agent sessions down 9.5x under load and 23x when long requests tie up the front end. Every output we checked matches the reference, among them 41.8 billion documents encoded by its fast encoder.
articles.comment: 42 pages (16-page main text, references, and supplementary material), 14 figures, 35 tables. The incremental tokenization path and the fast encoder are open source in toktier at https://github.com/asu-idi/toktier. The chunk-parallel path, the CPU pool scheduler, and the SGLang adapter will be released in the same repository
articles.titleCn: Delta分词器：会话增量参考一致分词及多核CPU上的长提示段并行处理
articles.abstractCn: 一个驱动大型语言模型的代理会反复向模型发送相同的对话，并且每次对话只添加少量文本。推理引擎会重用共享前缀的KV缓存，因此只有新的token会通过模型。然而，分词没有这样的捷径。服务引擎的CPU前端会从每个请求的第一个字符开始将其转换成token ID，这延长了首次token生成时间（TTFT）并消耗了每一轮的CPU资源。我们提出了Delta Tokenizer，这是一种CPU分词前端，它只对同一会话中请求与先前请求之间的差异进行分词。它保留先前的token序列，仅重新编码附加文本和可能受附加内容影响的短尾部分，并在分词器自身的分割规则无法移动的位置将两者连接起来，从而保持结果精确。对于没有可重用状态的长期请求，它在实用分词器已经将相邻部分保持独立的合理位置切割文本，同时在多个核心上并行编码这些部分，并将输出精确地连接成参考编码。共享CPU池将这些块与短增量更新一起调度，因此更新会在两个块之间运行，而不是在漫长的整个任务之后运行。增量路径相对于Hugging Face参考分词器将会话一轮的分词速度缩短了约40倍，在16个核心上，块并行路径比串行编码快8.2倍，比LoPT快1.6-2.1倍。在SGLang中，Delta Tokenizer通过聊天界面将100K token时的中位数TTFT降低了59%，并在负载下将代理会话的P99 TTFT降低了9.5倍，在长期请求阻塞前端时降低了23倍。我们检查的所有输出都与参考匹配，其中包括其快速编码器编码的418亿份文档。

articles.title: Evolve Together, Fall into Place: How Social Scaffolding Shapes Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Systems
articles.abstract: Recent work lets LLM agents evolve their own harness, up to the team itself. Yet in human groups, the same abilities achieve different outcomes under different social conditions. Borrowing the notion of scaffolding from developmental psychology, we investigate whether the social scaffolding of a self-evolving multi-agent system (MAS), namely its team composition and structure of interdependence (e.g., collaboration, conformity, or competition), shapes how the team evolves. We present AGORA (Agents Growing through Organization and Relational Arrangements), a framework that varies the two axes independently across three evolution mechanisms. Across web search, codebase understanding, and document QA, we find that (1) evolution alone rarely helps, while the right scaffolding surpasses a strong agent evolved alone by up to 25 points; (2) it does so by moving authority to the most capable member while the others step back; and (3) this member, having grown within the team, outperforms the same model alone. Designing a self-evolving MAS thus requires designing its social scaffolding, which shapes not only how its agents learn, but who gets to lead.
articles.titleCn: 协同进化，自然契合：社会支架如何塑造自我进化的多智能体系统
articles.abstractCn: 近期研究允许大语言模型代理进化自己的工具，甚至可以由团队自身完成。然而，在人类群体中，相同的能力在不同社会条件下会带来不同的结果。借鉴发展心理学中的脚手架概念，我们研究了自我进化的多智能体系统（MAS）的社会脚手架，即其团队组成和相互依赖结构（例如合作、从众或竞争），是否塑造了团队的进化方式。我们提出了AGORA（通过组织和关系安排进行成长的代理），这是一个在三种进化机制中独立变化两个轴的框架。在网页搜索、代码库理解和文档问答任务中，我们发现（1）单独进化很少有帮助，而合适的脚手架可以超过单独进化形成的强大代理多达25分；（2）这是通过将权力移交给最能力的成员，而其他人退让来实现的；（3）这个成员在团队中成长，表现优于单独的相同模型。因此，设计一个自我进化的MAS需要设计其社会脚手架，这不仅能塑造其代理的学习方式，还能决定谁可以领导。

articles.title: Learning Perception to Action Rules through Reinforcement Learning for Theory-of-Mind Reasoning
articles.abstract: In Theory-of-Mind (ToM) reasoning, large language models may correctly infer the agent's mental state but fail to use that inference when predicting or judging the agent's subsequent actions. In this work, we investigate whether explicitly connecting perception, belief, and action with rules improves ToM reasoning. We generate concise \textit{if--then} rules that express relations between perception to action and use Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to train Qwen2.5 and Llama3 models across four ToM benchmarks. GRPO with rule generation outperforms prompting, supervised fine-tuning, and think reasoning. Moreover, rules generated by larger models ($\geq$3B) provide transferable knowledge that improves downstream performance of GPT-4o-mini. These findings suggest that explicit rules help models bridge the reasoning gap in ToM and support knowledge transfer across models.
articles.titleCn: 通过强化学习学习感知到行动的规则以进行心智理论推理
articles.abstractCn: 在心智理论（ToM）推理中，大型语言模型可能正确推断主体的心理状态，但在预测或判断主体的后续行为时却未能利用该推断。在本工作中，我们研究了通过显式地将感知、信念和行动与规则连接起来是否能够改善ToM推理。我们生成了简洁的\textit{if--then}规则，用以表达感知到行动之间的关系，并使用组相对策略优化（GRPO）在四个ToM基准测试中训练Qwen2.5和Llama3模型。带有规则生成的GRPO优于提示、监督微调和思维推理。此外，由更大模型（$\geq$3B）生成的规则提供了可迁移的知识，提升了GPT-4o-mini的下游性能。这些发现表明，显式规则有助于模型弥合ToM中的推理差距，并支持跨模型的知识迁移。

articles.title: JetSpec++: Foresight Parallel Drafting with Self Refinements
articles.abstract: Speculative decoding's effectiveness is governed by two quantities: the acceptance rate of drafted tokens and the cost of producing them. We show the two objectives can be co-optimized with algorithm-system co-design, and present JetSpec++, which retains a strong learned draft model while hiding its cost almost entirely. JetSpec++ combines three components: intra-block self refinement, which trains the draft model to iteratively correct its own parallel predictions within a block of tokens; inter-block foresight drafting, which begins the next block before the current one is verified; and pipelined drafting and verification, which overlaps the two stages so drafting's marginal wall-clock cost approaches zero. In comparison with state-of-the-art speculative decoding methods, JetSpec++ attains a wall-clock speedup of up to $7.45\times$ over autoregressive (AR) decoding and $1.54\times$ over DSpark, with up to 1,361 tokens per second for a single request on GB200, and an average acceptance length of 8.94 across seven benchmarks, while preserving the target model's output distribution. Our code and models are available at https://github.com/hao-ai-lab/JetSpec.
articles.comment: 31 pages, 4 figures, 16 tables. Zhaoxiang Feng and Lanxiang Hu contributed equally. Code and models: https://github.com/hao-ai-lab/JetSpec
articles.titleCn: JetSpec++：具有自我改进的前瞻性并行绘图
articles.abstractCn: 推测解码的有效性由两个量决定：草稿令牌的接受率和生成它们的成本。我们展示了这两个目标可以通过算法-系统协同设计来协同优化，并提出了JetSpec++，它在保留强大的学习草稿模型的同时，几乎隐藏了其成本。JetSpec++结合了三个组件：区块内自优化，该组件训练草稿模型在令牌区块内迭代修正其并行预测；区块间前瞻草稿，该组件在当前区块验证之前开始下一个区块；以及流水线草稿和验证，该组件使两个阶段重叠，使草稿的边际时钟成本接近零。与最先进的推测解码方法相比，JetSpec++在自回归（AR）解码上实现了高达7.45倍的时钟速度提升，在DSpark上实现了1.54倍的速度提升，在GB200上每请求高达1361个令牌，在七个基准测试中的平均接受长度为8.94，同时保留了目标模型的输出分布。我们的代码和模型可在https://github.com/hao-ai-lab/JetSpec获取。

articles.title: More Methods, Better Agents? A Reality Check on Self-Distillation in Agentic Reinforcement Learning
articles.abstract: Self-distillation in agentic reinforcement learning has produced a growing number of methods. However, existing evaluations often reuse published baseline scores under differing experimental conditions, provide few direct comparisons among contemporaneous methods, and give limited attention to training stability and computational cost. These limitations obscure the source of reported gains and the practical strengths and weaknesses of competing methods. Costly agent training further motivates a common basis for comparison. To address these gaps, we compare ten representative methods against GRPO on ALFWorld, ScienceWorld, Search-QA, and WebShop across three model sizes. Our study comprises 132 training runs totaling 12,124.4 recorded H800 GPU-hours, with repeated evaluations over eight rollout seeds for the pretrained backbones and all eleven trained methods. Beyond final task performance, we examine training progress, stability, and measured computational cost. Our evaluation yields three key findings. First, gains over GRPO remain limited in scope, with no method consistently outperforming it across settings. Second, strong final performance can mask unstable training. Third, additional training cost does not consistently translate into better performance. We establish this benchmark to support fair, comprehensive comparison and guide future research toward reliable and cost-effective improvements in agent training. Project page: https://aim-uofa.github.io/Self-Distillation-AgentRL/
articles.titleCn: 更多方法，更好的智能体？对智能体强化学习中自我蒸馏的现实检验
articles.abstractCn: 在智能体强化学习中，自蒸馏技术已产生越来越多的方法。然而，现有的评估往往在不同实验条件下重复使用已发表的基线分数，缺乏对同时代方法之间的直接比较，且对训练稳定性和计算成本的关注有限。这些局限性掩盖了所报告收益的来源以及竞争方法的实际优缺点。昂贵的智能体训练进一步促使建立共同的比较基准。为解决这些差距，我们在ALFWorld、ScienceWorld、Search-QA和WebShop上，针对三种模型大小，将十种代表性方法与GRPO进行了比较。我们的研究包含132次训练运行，总共记录了12,124.4小时的H800 GPU时间，并对预训练的骨干网络和所有11种训练方法在八个 rollout 种子进行了重复评估。除了最终任务性能外，我们还考察了训练进度、稳定性以及测量的计算成本。我们的评估得出三个关键发现。首先，相对于GRPO的收益范围仍然有限，没有一种方法在所有设置中始终表现优于它。其次，优异的最终性能可能掩盖训练的不稳定性。第三，额外的训练成本并不总是转化为更好的性能。我们建立这个基准以支持公平、全面的比较，并指导未来研究朝着可靠且成本效益高的智能体训练改进方向发展。项目页面：https://aim-uofa.github.io/Self-Distillation-AgentRL/

articles.title: Likelihood Is Not Authorship: Can We Reliably Measure Human Contribution in AI-Assisted Writing?
articles.abstract: AI-text detection generally asks whether a machine wrote a text. As AI becomes an increasingly integral and accepted part of writing, the more relevant question is no longer whether AI was used, but how much of the text reflects human contribution. A prominent line of work estimates this by measuring how predictive a person's prompt is of the final text. We show that this measure can be easily manipulated. We introduce SPECIFICITY PADDING that simply asks the model to copy a few random IDs from the prompt, and that alone makes a title-only request look more human than one that supplies the article's key ideas. A context-swap audit then holds each document fixed, and only shows or hides the IDs to the evaluator. The score of the unchanged text swings by a third to half of its scale, and it rises for every document we test, on news and scientific abstracts, across varied LLMs from 3.8B to 753B parameters. The same articles can average 85\% human or 15\% human depending only on which prompt is on record, and even with no prompt at all, the output-only variant rewards the random strings themselves. An exact identity, the credit ledger, explains why. The score is a surprisal-weighted average over the text, so rare strings that the context makes copyable collect the credit, whatever they mean. A two-point bound marks a deeper limit. If the prompt could have been machine-written, every transcript-only method must, in the worst case, miss by half the contribution at stake. Likelihood-based scores alone cannot reliably establish human contribution without evidence of what the person added and how the text was produced.
articles.titleCn: 似然并非作者身份：我们能可靠地衡量人工智能辅助写作中的人类贡献吗？
articles.abstractCn: AI文本检测通常旨在判断文本是否由机器生成。随着AI逐渐成为写作不可或缺且被广泛接受的组成部分，更具相关性的问题已不再是是否使用了AI，而是文本中有多少反映了人类的贡献。一项突出研究通过测量用户提示对最终文本的预测性来估计这一贡献。我们证明这种衡量标准极易被操控。我们引入了SPECIFICITY PADDING技术，即要求模型从提示中复制几个随机ID，仅此操作就使仅提供标题的请求看起来比提供文章关键要点的请求更像是人类创作。随后进行的上下文交换审计将每份文档固定，仅向评估者展示或隐藏这些ID。未更改文本的评分会波动三分之一至一半的量级，且在我们测试的所有文档中，无论新闻摘要还是科学摘要，跨越从3.8B到753B参数的不同LLM，评分都会持续上升。同一篇文章的平均人类贡献率可在85%和15%之间变化，完全取决于记录在案的提示内容，即使没有提示，仅输出变体也会奖励这些随机字符串本身。精确的对应关系——信用账本——解释了原因。评分是基于文本的surprisal加权平均值，因此上下文使得可复制的稀有字符串会获得信用，无论其含义如何。一个两分的界限标志着更深层次的限制。如果提示可能是机器生成的，那么在最坏情况下，任何仅依赖文本记录的方法都必须错失所涉贡献的一半。仅基于似然评分的方法无法在没有用户添加内容及文本生成方式证据的情况下可靠地确定人类贡献。

articles.title: PRISMATIC : Prescription Risk Inspection System for Multi-Agent Treatment Interaction in Clinical Decision-Making
articles.abstract: Medical prescribing errors for multimorbid patients, who require complex drug regimens, are a major patient safety concern. These errors often stem from fragmented decision-making across medical specialties, a critical coordination failure that leads to adverse drug events and rehospitalizations. To address this coordination challenge, we introduce PRISMATIC, a multi-agent architecture where specialized agents, each representing a workflow role, collaboratively generate and refine treatment plans. Operating on a blackboard architecture, the system first structures patient information from clinical notes, then iteratively develops safe, rational, and interpretable drug regimens. The agents' collaboration is governed by two novel adaptive coordination mechanisms: (1) Dynamic Self-Updating Weight Adjustment (DSWA), a long-term mechanism that adjusts the influence weights of agents based on historical case outcomes, enabling the system to adapt and trust more reliable specialists over time. (2) Discrepancy Feedback Precise Calibration (DFPC), a short-term mechanism where agents provide iterative feedback to resolve disagreements and eliminate prescription conflicts for the current patient. Experiments on patient records from the MIMIC-IV database show that PRISMATIC significantly reduces drug conflicts, improves prescription coverage, and enhances treatment consistency compared to strong LLM baselines. Our work demonstrates that structuring clinical co-treatment as a multi-agent coordination problem offers a promising path toward safer and more coherent multidisease management.
articles.titleCn: 棱镜：多智能体治疗交互的临床决策风险处方检查系统
articles.abstractCn: 对于需要复杂用药方案的多病共存患者，医疗处方错误是主要的患者安全关切。这些错误通常源于跨医学专科的碎片化决策，这种关键的协调失败会导致不良药物事件和再住院。为应对这一协调挑战，我们引入了PRISMATIC，这是一种多智能体架构，其中每个代表工作流程角色的智能体协同生成和优化治疗方案。该系统基于黑板架构运行，首先从临床记录中结构化患者信息，然后迭代开发安全、合理且可解释的用药方案。智能体的协作受两种新型自适应协调机制调控：(1) 动态自更新权重调整（DSWA），这是一种长期机制，根据历史案例结果调整智能体的影响力权重，使系统能够随时间适应并信任更可靠的专家。(2) 差异反馈精确校准（DFPC），这是一种短期机制，智能体提供迭代反馈以解决分歧并消除当前患者的处方冲突。在MIMIC-IV数据库的患者记录上的实验表明，与强大的LLM基线相比，PRISMATIC显著减少了药物冲突，提高了处方覆盖率，并增强了治疗一致性。我们的工作证明，将临床协同治疗结构化为多智能体协调问题，为更安全、更一致的多病管理提供了有前景的路径。

articles.title: Qwen-MT-Lumen at WMT2026: Instruction-Specialized Translation via Quality-Aware Training and On-Policy Distillation
articles.abstract: We present Lumen, The open-source model is available at, our submission to the WMT 2026 General Machine Translation Shared Task. We focus on instruction-specialized translation, where systems must produce accurate translations while satisfying fine-grained requirements on style, terminology, and structured output. Lumen follows a four-stage pipeline. First, continued pre-training and supervised fine-tuning jointly strengthen multilingual translation competence and the ability to follow translation-specific instructions, such as terminology, style, and format constraints. Second, we extend the originally offline M^{2}PO preference-optimization framework into an online preference-optimization stage: the current policy samples candidate translations, an LLM judge assigns continuous direct-assessment scores, and the resulting multi-pair preferences are used to update the model. Third, on-policy distillation transfers stronger translation-instruction-following behavior from a larger teacher model to the Qwen3-14B student, improving translation-instruction adherence while retaining a 14B primary translation backbone. Finally, structure-aware inference and postprocessing preserve required formats, while selective repair addresses clear structural or decoding failures before submission. We participate in 23 translation directions. Under an absolute 1--5 LLM-judge rubric that evaluates translation-instruction following and translation quality separately, Lumen reaches an overall mean score of 4.60. Despite using a 14B translation backbone, it achieves performance comparable to leading proprietary systems in both translation quality and translation-instruction following.
articles.titleCn: Qwen-MT-Lumen在WMT2026：通过质量感知训练和在线策略蒸馏的指令专用翻译
articles.abstractCn: 我们介绍了Lumen，这是我们在WMT 2026通用机器翻译共享任务中提交的开源模型。我们专注于指令专业化翻译，要求系统在满足对风格、术语和结构化输出的细粒度要求的同时，生成准确的翻译。Lumen遵循一个四阶段流程。首先，持续预训练和监督微调共同增强了多语言翻译能力和遵循特定翻译指令的能力，例如术语、风格和格式约束。其次，我们将原本离线的M^{2}PO偏好优化框架扩展为在线偏好优化阶段：当前策略采样候选翻译，大型语言模型（LLM）裁判分配连续的直接评估分数，并将生成的多对偏好用于更新模型。第三，策略蒸馏将更强的翻译指令遵循行为从较大的教师模型转移到Qwen3-14B学生模型，在保持14B主要翻译主干的同时，提高了翻译指令的遵循度。最后，结构感知推理和后处理保留所需格式，而选择性修复在提交前解决明显的结构或解码失败。我们参与了23个翻译方向。在分别评估翻译指令遵循和翻译质量的绝对1--5 LLM裁判评分标准下，Lumen达到了4.60的整体平均分。尽管使用的是14B翻译主干，它在翻译质量和翻译指令遵循方面均达到了与领先专有系统相当的性能。

articles.title: Beyond Reachability: A Relation-Semantic Reasoning Framework for Biomedical Multi-hop QA
articles.abstract: Biomedical multi-hop reasoning over knowledge graphs requires identifying a semantically valid relation sequence that supports the answer. Existing methods can retrieve correct answers, yet often rank them poorly within a large pool of seemingly relevant candidates. Even when a correct answer is retrieved, its associated evidence and reasoning path may fail to support the relation composition required by the question. We term this disconnect between answer reachability and evidential validity the reachable-but-invalid problem. We present ReSemReason, which shares a question-induced distribution over typed, directed relation schemas between candidate discovery and evidence selection. Schema compatibility guides graph search; ReSemAttn then uses relation-conditioned key/value projections and an uncertainty-weighted path prior to attend to candidate-specific evidence. A separate absolute-support score complements normalized attention when all retrieved paths are weak. The reported experiments on BioHopR, PrimeKGQA, and MedReason show improvements in answer ranking and answer-set quality. Path-discrimination analyses examine the distinction between endpoint correctness and evidential support. We also specify matched controls for search, attention, and schema uncertainty.
articles.titleCn: 难以企及：一种用于生物医学多跳问答的关系语义推理框架
articles.abstractCn: 生物医学知识图谱的多跳推理需要识别一个支持答案的语义有效关系序列。现有方法能够检索到正确答案，但在大量看似相关的候选中往往排名不佳。即使检索到正确答案，其相关证据和推理路径也可能无法支持问题所需的关系组合。我们将答案可达性与证据有效性之间的这种脱节称为可达但无效问题。我们提出了ReSemReason，该方法在候选发现和证据选择之间共享由问题诱导的、关于类型化有向关系模式的分布。模式兼容性指导图搜索；ReSemAttn随后使用关系条件键/值投影和不确定性加权路径先验来关注特定候选的证据。一个独立的绝对支持分数在所有检索到的路径都较弱时补充归一化注意力。在BioHopR、PrimeKGQA和MedReason上的实验报告显示，答案排名和答案集质量均有所提升。路径区分分析考察了终点正确性与证据支持之间的区别。我们还为搜索、注意力和模式不确定性指定了匹配对照。

articles.title: Does the Linguistic Register of Thinking Matter? Wenyan as a Compact Reasoning Register for Chinese LLMs
articles.abstract: Visible reasoning traces of Chinese reasoning-oriented LLMs are typically written in modern vernacular Chinese, which may be verbose under limited decoding budgets. We ask whether the linguistic register of reasoning can be used to improve efficiency. We propose Wenyan Thinking, which emits intermediate reasoning in Classical Chinese (wenyanwen) while retaining a short direct-answer output. Starting from modern-Chinese reasoning traces, we rewrite only the reasoning field into wenyan and fine-tune Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507 on the rewritten supervision. To distinguish register shift from generic compression, we construct a compact modern-Chinese control using the same source data, teacher family, base model, and SFT recipe. Across budget-sensitive evaluations on MMLU-ProX-Lite-ZH, CEVAL, and AGIEval-CN, Wenyan Thinking substantially reduces reasoning length and missing-answer rates under constrained decoding. Compact rewriting explains much of the efficiency gain, while wenyan consistently outperforms the compact modern-Chinese control on the primary benchmark and remains competitive across the additional benchmarks. These results identify linguistic register as a practical design axis for efficient visible reasoning in Chinese LLMs.
articles.titleCn: 语言注册在思考中是否重要？文言文作为中国LLM的紧凑推理注册
articles.abstractCn: 可见推理的中文推理导向大语言模型通常以现代白话文书写，在有限的解码预算下可能显得冗长。我们探究推理语言的语域是否可用于提升效率。我们提出了“文言思考”方法，该方法在输出简短直接答案的同时，将中间推理以文言文（文言文）形式呈现。从现代中文推理轨迹出发，我们仅将推理字段重写为文言文，并在重写的监督数据上微调Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507模型。为区分语域转换与通用压缩，我们使用相同源数据、教师家族、基础模型和SFT配方构建紧凑的现代中文对照。在MMLU-ProX-Lite-ZH、CEVAL和AGIEval-CN等预算敏感评估中，“文言思考”在约束解码下显著缩短推理长度并降低未答题率。紧凑重写解释了大部分效率提升，而文言文在主要基准测试中始终优于紧凑现代中文对照，并在其他基准测试中保持竞争力。这些结果将语言语域确立为中文大语言模型高效可见推理的实用设计维度。

articles.title: MakSafe: A Spatiotemporal Semantic Framework for Formal Specification and Compliance Checking of Road Vehicle Safety Rules
articles.abstract: Scenario-based validation is essential for automated road vehicles but cannot cover the full variability of openworld traffic. We present MakSafe, a formal spatiotemporal framework for specifying and checking road vehicle safety rules through semantic zones, action-based forecasting, and trace-tree reasoning, avoiding uniform time discretization. We formalize the road network, vehicle states, and occupancy zones, then build executable rules for front-vehicle identification and timeto-collision (TTC) verification. The evaluation combines a tracedependent case study with a scalability benchmark over traffic density (N ), horizon (H), and branch factor (B). MakSafe yields branch-specific verdicts, deriving safe and unsafe outcomes from the same initial scene, and re-evaluates a scenario after a control update. A single rule check stays well below a millisecond across the reported sweep, and longer horizons slow the TTC check.
articles.titleCn: MakSafe：一种用于道路车辆安全规则形式化规范与合规性检查的时空语义框架
articles.abstractCn: 基于场景的验证对于自动驾驶车辆至关重要，但无法覆盖开放世界交通的全部变异性。我们提出了MakSafe，一个形式化的时空框架，通过语义区域、基于动作的预测和轨迹树推理来指定和检查道路车辆安全规则，避免了统一的时序离散化。我们形式化了道路网络、车辆状态和占用区域，然后构建了用于前车识别和碰撞时间（TTC）验证的可执行规则。评估结合了基于轨迹的案例研究和在交通密度（N）、视野（H）和分支因子（B）上的可扩展性基准测试。MakSafe生成特定分支的判定结果，从相同的初始场景中推导出安全和危险的结果，并在控制更新后重新评估场景。单个规则检查在整个报告的范围内均保持在毫秒以下，而更长的视野会减慢TTC检查。

articles.title: Mitigating Video Hallucinations via Attention-Guided Representation Perturbation
articles.abstract: Video large language models (Video LLMs) often generate responses unsupported by the input video. Contrastive decoding (CD) can mitigate these hallucinations, but its effectiveness depends on how the negative branch weakens visual evidence. Existing methods rely on predefined perturbations or masking guided by question reconstruction, offering limited control over the model's visual reliance during answer generation. We introduce Attention-guided Representation Perturbation for Contrastive Decoding (ARP-CD), a training-free framework for constructing contrastive negatives directly in representation space. ARP-CD uses the attention mass assigned to visual tokens at the answer-prediction position to guide bounded gradient updates of the language model's input visual hidden states. These updates reduce visual attention and produce a negative input, whose predictions are contrasted with those of the original branch throughout generation. Experiments across four Video LLMs and four benchmarks show that ARP-CD outperforms representative training-free baselines in most model--benchmark settings, reducing hallucinations while improving general video understanding. Further analyses show that attention-guided perturbation directions improve negative quality and that the resulting negatives provide effective contrastive references for correcting the original predictions.
articles.titleCn: 通过注意力引导表示扰动来缓解视频幻觉
articles.abstractCn: 视频大型语言模型（Video LLMs）常常生成与输入视频内容不符的回应。对比解码（CD）可以缓解这些幻觉现象，但其效果取决于负分支如何削弱视觉证据。现有方法依赖于预定义的扰动或基于问题重建的掩码引导，对生成答案时模型对视觉信息的依赖控制有限。我们引入了注意力引导表征扰动对比解码（ARP-CD），这是一个无需训练的框架，可以直接在表征空间构建对比负样本。ARP-CD利用在答案预测位置分配给视觉标记的注意力权重，引导语言模型输入视觉隐藏状态的有限梯度更新。这些更新会降低视觉注意力，并生成一个负输入，其预测结果在整个生成过程中与原始分支的预测结果进行对比。在四个视频LLMs和四个基准测试上的实验表明，ARP-CD在大多数模型-基准设置中优于代表性的无训练基线，减少了幻觉现象并提升了视频理解能力。进一步分析显示，注意力引导的扰动方向提升了负样本质量，且生成的负样本为纠正原始预测提供了有效的对比参考。

articles.title: Recognizing Dialogue Ambiguity via Candidate Set Visual Grounding
articles.abstract: Interpreting an ambiguous utterance in real-world interactions often requires context beyond a single utterance. When the utterance refers to objects in a visual scene, it is necessary to maintain and update the set of plausible referents as context accumulates, without assuming that the available information identifies a unique object. However, prior work on interactive visual grounding, which localizes objects referred to by linguistic expressions, has focused on identifying a unique object once sufficient dialogue context becomes available. To address this gap, we propose Candidate Set Visual Grounding (CSVG), a task for estimating the set of objects consistent with the given dialogue context. We further introduce CandVG, a benchmark that evaluates how the candidate set changes across dialogue turns. Our evaluation of vision-language models shows that stronger visual grounding capability does not necessarily yield better CSVG performance. In particular, models have difficulty predicting the complete candidate set, owing to challenges in candidate generation and premature commitment to a small set of candidates in early turns. Nevertheless, we find that this limitation can be partially mitigated in the evaluated large-scale models using instructions designed for CSVG.
articles.titleCn: 通过候选集视觉定位识别对话歧义
articles.abstractCn: 在现实世界交互中，对模糊话语的解释通常需要超越单个话语的上下文。当话语涉及视觉场景中的物体时，随着上下文的积累，有必要维持和更新一组可能的指称对象，而不假设现有信息能唯一确定某个物体。然而，先前关于交互式视觉基础的研究，即定位语言表达所指的物体，主要关注在足够的对话上下文出现时识别一个唯一物体。为了弥补这一空白，我们提出了候选集视觉基础（CSVG），这是一个任务，用于估计与给定对话上下文一致的对象集。我们进一步引入了CandVG，一个基准，用于评估候选集如何随对话轮次变化。我们对视觉语言模型的评估表明，更强的视觉基础能力并不一定带来更好的CSVG性能。具体而言，由于候选生成困难和早期轮次过早地锁定少数候选对象，模型在预测完整候选集方面存在困难。尽管如此，我们发现使用为CSVG设计的指令，可以在所评估的大规模模型中部分缓解这一局限性。

articles.title: Articulation Upper Bounds for Language Models
articles.abstract: Language captures only a subset of the perceptions, intuitions and intents that form meaning between speakers. What, then, are the limits of language? We take steps towards measuring this in LLMs as follows: for a set of concepts, we measure how well each concept can be transmitted between two LLMs as their capabilities scale. This requires novel measurement tools: (1) optimal messages: we introduce a prompt optimization algorithm that beats existing algorithms by up to 14% on benchmarks and accurately estimates prompt upper bounds. (2) A transmission measure: the sender is asked to label text; the receiver then tries to recover the sender's prompt, and recovery is measured; we find this correlates strongly with human label error. With these measures, we use observational scaling laws to study how transmissibility of a concept, conveyed with optimal messages, increases as transmitter and receiver capacity grows: does it asymptote below or above a threshold? Measuring 1.2k concepts in eight domains, we find concepts that (a) can be fully articulated; these concepts usually depend on local patterns, e.g. "joke ends with surprise"; (b) might be articulated by future, stronger models; these rely on whole-text structural patterns, e.g. "story's worldbuilding coherence"; (c) concepts that face articulability limits; these concepts' meaning, we find, is tied to identity and social-group awareness, e.g. "comic voice". Interesting, these same concepts are not all challenging for humans: humans have moderate-to-high levels of agreement in 76% of concepts that LLMs struggle with; articulation limits, we find, are executor relative. Finally, we characterize the nature of improvement in each case: while recoverable concepts can be articulated through definitions and explanations, irrecoverable concepts cannot be transmitted, even with examples, and might require novel learning mechanisms.
articles.titleCn: 语言模型的 articulation 上界
articles.abstractCn: 语言仅能捕捉说话者之间形成意义所依赖的部分感知、直觉和意图。那么，语言的局限在哪里？我们通过以下方式在大型语言模型（LLMs）中逐步测量这一点：对于一组概念，我们测量每个概念在两个LLMs之间传输的效果，随着它们能力的提升。这需要新型测量工具：（1）最优消息：我们引入了一种提示优化算法，在基准测试中比现有算法提高了14%，并能准确估计提示的上限。（2）传输度量：发送者被要求对文本进行标记；接收者随后尝试恢复发送者的提示，并测量恢复效果；我们发现这与人类标记错误高度相关。借助这些测量工具，我们使用观察性缩放定律来研究，当一个概念通过最优消息传达时，随着传输者和接收者能力的增长，其可传输性是否会趋近于某个阈值之下或之上？测量了八个领域中1.2k个概念，我们发现：（a）可以完全表达的概念；这些概念通常依赖于局部模式，例如“笑话以惊喜结尾”；（b）可能被未来更强大的模型表达的概念；这些概念依赖于全文结构模式，例如“故事世界观的一致性”；（c）面临表达局限的概念；我们发现，这些概念的意义与身份和社会群体意识相关，例如“漫画声音”。有趣的是，这些概念并非都对人类构成挑战：在LLMs难以处理的概念中，人类在76%的概念上具有中等到较高的共识；我们发现表达局限是相对执行者的。最后，我们描述了每种情况下改进的性质：可恢复的概念可以通过定义和解释来表达，而不可恢复的概念即使通过示例也无法传输，可能需要新型学习机制。

articles.title: Beyond State Capacity: Why Retrieval Breaks in Mamba
articles.abstract: Mamba models underperform Transformers on in-context retrieval. This gap is usually attributed to Mamba's fixed-size recurrent state, which loses information as the context grows. We challenge this assumption by focusing on query-first retrieval, a setup in which the query precedes the context and state capacity should not be the binding constraint. We show that even in this setting Mamba lags substantially behind Transformers, despite its selection mechanism, which was designed to distinguish relevant content from distractors. We then demonstrate that the Mamba selection gates have sufficient control over the state updates to influence the model output: intervening on specific gates alone can swing accuracy between extremes. However, as gates are input-dependent, they require the incoming token's representation to encode its relevance to the query. We therefore probe token representations across layers, and find that the relevance signal emerges only gradually with model depth, and that the gates begin to reflect it only several layers deeper. Crucially, we find that gates in retrieval-critical layers are not yet aligned with relevance. The selection mechanism is thus expressive enough to solve the task, but it commonly operates on a relevance signal that has not yet arrived. Mamba's retrieval bottleneck therefore extends beyond state capacity: even when capacity is sufficient, the delayed emergence of relevance information across depth often prevents successful retrieval.
articles.titleCn: 超越国家能力：为什么Mamba的检索会中断
articles.abstractCn: Mamba模型在情境检索任务中的表现不如Transformer模型。这种差距通常归因于Mamba固定大小的循环状态，随着上下文的增长，该状态会丢失信息。我们通过关注查询优先检索这一设置来挑战这一假设，在这种设置中，查询先于上下文出现，状态容量不应是限制因素。我们表明，即使在这种设置下，Mamba的表现也显著落后于Transformer模型，尽管其选择机制旨在区分相关内容与干扰项。我们随后证明，Mamba的选择门控对状态更新具有足够的控制力，能够影响模型输出：单独干预特定的门控即可使准确率在极端值之间波动。然而，由于门控依赖于输入，它们需要将输入标记的相关性编码到其表示中。因此，我们探究了跨层的标记表示，发现相关性信号仅在模型深度逐渐增强，而门控直到更深几层才开始反映这一信号。关键在于，检索关键层中的门控尚未与相关性对齐。因此，选择机制足够表达力以解决该任务，但它通常作用于尚未到达的相关性信号。Mamba的检索瓶颈因此超越了状态容量：即使容量充足，深度中相关性信息的延迟出现往往会导致检索失败。

articles.title: RouteWeaver: Weaving Mode Selection and Execution into Unified LLM Routing
articles.abstract: LLM routing dynamically selects and coordinates heterogeneous language models across diverse tasks. However, existing approaches are largely built around a predefined execution paradigm, such as single-round, multi-round, or agentic routing, which fixes how model calls are organized and limits adaptation to different query needs. We propose RouteWeaver, a unified routing framework that integrates these routing modes within a single LLM policy, jointly learning which mode to use and how to select models within that mode. To jointly optimize mode selection and within-mode execution, we develop COMET-GRPO (COordinated Mode-Execution Training), which decouples the trajectory-level advantage into separate signals for mode selection and within-mode execution, enabling more targeted credit assignment to each decision level. We further introduce progressive exploration, which gradually shifts training from externally assigned modes to autonomous selection, so that the router first learns how to execute each mode before deciding when to use it. We evaluate RouteWeaver across mathematics, coding, knowledge, logical reasoning, and factual recall. RouteWeaver achieves an average accuracy of 61.4%, an 11.03% relative improvement over the strongest baseline, and outperforms all compared baselines in each of the five domains. Ablations show that both COMET-GRPO and progressive exploration are important for adaptive routing; without progressive exploration, the routing policy collapses entirely to single-round execution.
articles.titleCn: RouteWeaver：将统一LLM路由中的编织模式选择和执行
articles.abstractCn: LLM路由能够动态地选择和协调不同任务中的异构语言模型。然而，现有方法大多基于预定义的执行范式，如单轮、多轮或代理式路由，这些范式固定了模型调用的组织方式，并限制了适应不同查询需求的能力。我们提出了RouteWeaver，一个统一的路由框架，将多种路由模式集成在单个LLM策略中，联合学习应使用哪种模式以及在该模式内如何选择模型。为了联合优化模式选择和模式内执行，我们开发了COMET-GRPO（协同模式执行训练），将轨迹级的优势解耦为模式选择和模式内执行的不同信号，从而能够更有针对性地对每个决策层级进行归因。我们进一步引入了渐进式探索，逐步将训练从外部分配的模式转移到自主选择，使得路由器首先学习如何执行每种模式，然后再决定何时使用它。我们在数学、编程、知识、逻辑推理和事实回忆等多个领域评估了RouteWeaver。RouteWeaver实现了61.4%的平均准确率，比最强的基线相对提高了11.03%，并在五个领域的每个领域都优于所有比较基线。消融实验表明，COMET-GRPO和渐进式探索对于自适应路由都很重要；如果没有渐进式探索，路由策略完全崩溃为单轮执行。

articles.title: BANGLAPLAN: A Benchmark for Constraint-Based Planning and Decision-Making in Bangla
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly help users arrange appointments, plan journeys, and allocate limited resources. These tasks require models to satisfy constraints on time, cost, capacity, and order, or determine that no feasible solution exists. Bangla is the world's seventh most widely spoken language, and existing benchmarks cover many language and reasoning tasks. However, benchmarks for evaluating planning and decision-making in Bangla under explicit constraints remain lacking. We introduce BANGLAPLAN, a benchmark of 1,000 problems across ten task families grounded in everyday life and institutions in Bangladesh. It includes feasible and infeasible problems in four language registers: everyday, formal, colloquial, and Bangla--English mixed. Answers cover eight structured types, including schedules, routes, allocations, and ordered steps, in a common JSON format. We construct the benchmark through language-model-assisted drafting and independent human validation. We evaluate 11 open-weight and proprietary model configurations using exact match, separately reporting feasible-case accuracy, infeasibility detection, and format errors. We find a large performance gap: GPT-6.1 Sol achieves 98.7% accuracy and Qwen3.5-27B with thinking reaches 80.3%, while direct-answer configurations score at most 30.9%. Seven of eleven configurations perform below the always-``infeasible'' baseline. Our findings also suggest that harder problems primarily reduce plan-construction accuracy, while infeasibility detection remains more robust. BANGLAPLAN provides a reproducible basis for evaluating planning and decision-making in Bangla. BANGLAPLAN is available at: https://github.com/mrayhanulmasud/banglaplan.
articles.titleCn: BANGLAPLAN：用于孟加拉语约束规划与决策的基准
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地帮助用户安排约会、规划旅程和分配有限资源。这些任务要求模型满足时间、成本、容量和顺序等方面的约束，或者确定不存在可行的解决方案。孟加拉语是世界上最广泛使用的第七种语言，现有的基准涵盖了多种语言和推理任务。然而，在明确约束下评估孟加拉语规划和决策能力的基准仍然缺乏。我们介绍了BANGLAPLAN，这是一个包含1000个问题的基准，分为十个基于孟加拉国日常生活和机构的任务系列。它包括四种语言语域（日常、正式、口语和孟加拉语-英语混合）中的可行和不可行问题。答案涵盖八种结构化类型，包括时间表、路线、分配和有序步骤，并以常见的JSON格式提供。我们通过语言模型辅助起草和独立人工验证来构建该基准。我们使用精确匹配评估了11个开放权重和专有模型配置，分别报告可行案例的准确率、不可行性检测和格式错误。我们发现存在巨大的性能差距：GPT-6.1 Sol达到了98.7%的准确率，而Qwen3.5-27B在思考时达到了80.3%，直接回答配置的得分最高仅为30.9%。11个配置中有7个低于始终为“不可行”的基线。我们的研究还表明，更难的问题主要降低了计划构建的准确率，而不可行性检测仍然更为稳健。BANGLAPLAN为评估孟加拉语的规划和决策提供了一个可重复的基础。BANGLAPLAN可在以下网址获取：https://github.com/mrayhanulmasud/banglaplan。

articles.title: Share the Symbol, Not the Vector: Training-Free Fact Communication Across Language Models
articles.abstract: Multi-agent systems allow language models to solve tasks collaboratively by sharing complementary information. These systems typically communicate through text, while recent approaches also explore exchanging internal model states. However, sharing these states across architectures often requires learned translators or assumptions about model compatibility. We introduce SYNC (Symbol-Indexed Neural Communication), a word-indexed interface that connects heterogeneous models without fine-tuning or a learned translator. From descriptions only it can see, the sender selects words from a shared list and sends their indices for each object, without seeing the questions. The receiver writes the described facts into its hidden states using its own word directions, vectors fitted once from its activations. We test selective use by swapping one attribute between two objects and requiring correct answers about both changed and unchanged attributes before and after the swap, four answers in total. We choose an early write layer on four development receivers and then fix it. With three different senders and nine newer receivers from five families, four-answer success on new scenes reaches 72.0-98.3%, up to 96 percentage points above middle-layer writing, and the two largest receivers match plain text. A task-free probe predicted in advance which depths each new receiver can use (45 of 45 cases). Without retuning, messages listing every fact keep 89.6-100% success under new layouts, and sender messages reach 23.9-64.0% on a landmark task with multi-token symbols, below text but from 0% without a message. These results show that shared word indices and receiver-local directions can support selective fact use across model families without additional training.

articles.titleCn: 共享符号，而非向量：跨语言模型的无需训练的事实通信
articles.abstractCn: 多智能体系统允许语言模型通过共享互补信息协作完成任务。这些系统通常通过文本进行通信，而最近的方法还探索了交换内部模型状态。然而，跨架构共享这些状态通常需要学习型翻译器或对模型兼容性的假设。我们介绍了SYNC（符号索引神经通信），这是一种基于单词索引的接口，无需微调或学习型翻译器即可连接异构模型。发送者仅根据描述信息，从共享列表中选择单词，并发送每个对象的索引，而无需看到问题。接收者使用自己的单词方向将其描述的事实写入其隐藏状态，这些方向是从其激活中一次性拟合的。我们通过在两个对象之间交换一个属性，并要求在交换前后对更改和未更改属性的正确答案进行测试，总共四个答案，来测试选择性使用。我们在四个开发接收器上选择了一个早期写入层，然后将其固定。使用三个不同的发送器和来自五个系列的九个更新的接收器，在新场景中四个答案的成功率达到72.0-98.3%，比中间层写入高出高达96个百分点，并且两个最大的接收器与纯文本匹配。一个无任务的探测预先预测了每个新接收器可以使用哪些深度（45个案例中的45个）。在不重新调优的情况下，列出每个事实的消息在新布局下保持89.6-100%的成功率，发送者消息在具有多标记符号的地标任务上达到23.9-64.0%，低于文本但无消息时为0%。这些结果表明，共享单词索引和接收器本地方向可以在无需额外训练的情况下支持跨模型家族的选择性事实使用。

articles.title: Function-Space Temporal Self-Distillation for Policy Optimization
articles.abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) improves reasoning in language models, but scalar outcomes provide coarse supervision over response trajectories. Self-distillation offers denser token-level guidance by comparing an unassisted policy with a feedback-informed self-teacher, yet the teacher evolves with the student, creating unstable targets and motivating additional regularization. We introduce Function-Space Policy Optimization (FSPO), a single-policy framework that combines current privileged adaptation with function-space temporal consolidation. FSPO stores sparse historical next-token distributions as fixed temporal targets, providing temporal separation without maintaining a persistent teacher model. It further introduces privileged disagreement correction to explicitly suppress locally overvalued actions, reliability-adaptive grounding that strengthens reference supervision when self-generated evidence repeatedly fails, and quality and coverage-aware temporal memory that retains verified behaviors and improves privileged demonstrations. Across reasoning and tool-use benchmarks, FSPO achieves the highest average accuracy under a 5-hour training budget, improving over the strongest baseline by approximately 4% points on average while reducing peak memory from about 70 GB to 56 GB on Olmo3-7B-Instruct.

articles.titleCn: 基于函数空间的时序自蒸馏策略优化
articles.abstractCn: 具有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）提升了语言模型的推理能力，但标量结果对响应轨迹的监督较为粗糙。自蒸馏通过比较无辅助策略与反馈指导的自教师，提供了更密集的token级指导，然而教师的进化导致目标不稳定，从而需要额外的正则化。我们引入了函数空间策略优化（FSPO），这是一种单策略框架，结合了当前的特权适应与函数空间时间整合。FSPO将稀疏的历史下一个token分布存储为固定的时序目标，提供时间分离而不需要维护一个持续的教师模型。它进一步引入了特权分歧校正来显式抑制局部高估的动作，可靠性自适应接地在自生成证据反复失败时加强参考监督，以及质量和覆盖感知时序记忆来保留验证行为并改进特权演示。在推理和工具使用基准测试中，FSPO在5小时训练预算下实现了最高的平均准确率，平均比最强的基线提高了约4个百分点，同时在Olmo3-7B-Instruct上将峰值内存从约70 GB减少到56 GB。

articles.title: Interlock: From Local Correctness to Task Completion in Long-Horizon Agents
articles.abstract: Large language model agents increasingly undertake long-horizon tasks in complex environments characterized by fragmented evidence, partially completed states, and dependencies across resources and artifacts. Existing agents may satisfy individual requirements while failing to maintain these relationships, producing locally correct but incomplete outcomes. These failures arise because task completion depends on relationships among environmental evidence, consequential decisions, and required effects. To address this completion gap, we propose Interlock, a framework for task synthesis that represents each task as a typed completion graph. Grounding edges connect public evidence to decisions, coupling hyperedges impose joint constraints across components, and realization edges connect decisions to all required downstream effects. Interlock compiles this graph into a resettable workspace, a public request, and an evaluation rubric. A source-coverage review checks whether the original requirements survive generation, while a public-input review checks whether the rubric is supported by the materials available to the solver. An agent-as-judge inspects execution artifacts and runs verification scripts, retaining trajectories judged to satisfy all mandatory requirements. To evaluate training utility, we fine-tune two Qwen3.6 backbones on their own accepted trajectories. Across the two backbones, training improves AutomationBench task pass rates by 4.00-4.50 percentage points, JobBench weighted scores by 3.20-6.64 points, and Harvey LAB criterion pass rates by 3.89-4.16 percentage points. These results demonstrate the training utility of the synthesized experience across external task environments.
articles.titleCn: 互锁：长时程智能体从局部正确性到任务完成
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型代理越来越多地承担复杂环境中的长时程任务，这些环境的特点是证据碎片化、状态部分完成以及资源和工件之间的依赖关系。现有代理可能在满足个体要求的同时无法维持这些关系，产生局部正确但不完整的成果。这些失败源于任务完成依赖于环境证据、后果决策和所需效果之间的关系。为解决这一完成差距，我们提出了Interlock，一个用于任务合成的框架，该框架将每个任务表示为一个带类型的完成图。基础边将公共证据连接到决策，耦合超边在组件之间施加联合约束，实现边将决策连接到所有必需的下游效果。Interlock将此图编译成一个可重置的工作区、一个公共请求和一个评估标准。源覆盖审查检查原始要求是否在生成过程中得以保留，而公共输入审查检查评估标准是否得到求解器可用的材料支持。代理作为法官检查执行工件并运行验证脚本，保留被判定满足所有强制性要求的轨迹。为评估训练效用，我们在各自的被接受轨迹上对两个Qwen3.6主干网络进行微调。在两个主干网络中，训练将AutomationBench任务通过率提高了4.00-4.50个百分点，JobBench加权得分提高了3.20-6.64分，Harvey LAB标准通过率提高了3.89-4.16个百分点。这些结果表明，合成经验在外部任务环境中具有训练效用。

articles.title: Beyond Distribution Matching: Selective Margin Preservation for Supervised Fine-Tuning
articles.abstract: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) changes logit margins among non-target tokens at teacher-forced prefixes. Matching a local reference distribution keeps those probabilities and also penalizes margin expansions. We ask whether a soft auxiliary can preserve selected local non-target margin relations without freezing that distribution. We introduce \textbf{Selective Rank-Preserving SFT (SRP-SFT)}, a soft margin target: a hinge on reference-scaled lower bounds for pairs from the reference's top-$K$ non-target tokens, applied at fixed teacher-forced prefixes. The hinge stops once the requested bound is met. We derive the KL cost of violating a margin, characterize the feasible region and its conditional utility, and give a finite-step condition for reducing aggregate violations. In one-epoch experiments on Qwen3-4B-Base and UltraFeedback, this target raises MATH-500 and code-generation scores over CE and LP-SFT at all three training seeds. At seed 1234, MATH-500 pass@1 rises from 49.56\% to 54.56\% and the four-metric code mean rises from 65.91\% to 69.50\% relative to LP-SFT. Ranking controls, held-out cache diagnostics, sensitivity sweeps, and six additional backbones show where these score changes appear.
articles.titleCn: 超越分布匹配：选择性边际保留的监督微调
articles.abstractCn: 监督微调（SFT）会改变教师强制前缀中非目标token的logit间隔。匹配局部参考分布可以保持这些概率，并惩罚间隔扩展。我们探究软辅助是否能在不冻结该分布的情况下保留选定的局部非目标间隔关系。我们引入了**选择性秩保持SFT（SRP-SFT）**，这是一种软间隔目标：在固定的教师强制前缀处，对参考分布中前K个非目标token对应用基于参考缩放下限的铰链。铰链一旦达到所需界限即停止。我们推导了违反间隔的KL成本，刻画了可行区域及其条件效用，并给出一个有限步条件以减少总违规量。在一epoch的Qwen3-4B-Base和UltraFeedback实验中，该目标在三个训练种子下均提升了MATH-500和代码生成分数，优于CE和LP-SFT。在种子1234下，MATH-500的pass@1从49.56%提升至54.56%，相对于LP-SFT，四指标代码平均分从65.91%提升至69.50%。排名控制、留出缓存诊断、敏感性扫描和六个额外backbone验证了这些分数变化的出现位置。

articles.title: Measuring and Reducing Unusable Replies of LLM Agents
articles.abstract: People delegate multi-step work to LLM agents and read only the reply that the agent hands back. Current evaluation scores task completion and the faithfulness of reports, and it leaves open whether the requester can understand and use the reply. We call this property reply usability and measure it with a reader model that takes the requester's position and tests whether the reply can be interpreted from what the requester has seen, is in the requester's language and answers the request. Its agreement with the majority of five annotators lies within the range of the individual annotators. Across eight models from seven families, 54% of 480 replies fail, and the best model still fails on 30%. Failed replies mostly point to material the requester has not seen or use labels that the agent coined during its work. Stating explicit requirements for the reply reduces the failure rate from 0.52 to 0.43 together with errors and omissions, and a secondary model that rewrites the reply reduces it to 0.36, which human annotators confirm in a blind comparison. Reply usability can thus be scored alongside task success and improved with one appended message or one call to a secondary model.
articles.titleCn: 测量和减少LLM代理的无用回复
articles.abstractCn: 人们将多步骤工作委托给大型语言模型代理，并只阅读代理返回的回复。当前的评估分数仅衡量任务完成度和报告的忠实度，并未明确请求者是否能够理解和使用回复。我们将此属性称为回复可用性，并使用一个以请求者视角为基准的模型来衡量，该模型测试回复是否能够从请求者所见内容中解读，是否使用请求者的语言，以及是否回答了请求。该模型与五位标注者的多数意见一致，误差范围在个体标注者之间。在七个家族的八个模型中，480个回复中有54%失败，最佳模型仍有30%的失败率。失败的回复主要指向请求者未看到的内容，或使用了代理在工作过程中创造的标签。明确要求回复内容可将错误率从0.52降至0.43（包括错误和遗漏），而一个重写回复的次级模型可将错误率进一步降至0.36，人类标注者在盲测中确认了这一结果。因此，回复可用性可以与任务成功度一同评分，并通过附加一条消息或调用一个次级模型来改进。

articles.title: HACHIMI-II: From Role-Play to Learner Behavior Modeling for Faithful Student Simulation
articles.abstract: Simulated students let researchers test tutoring systems and teaching strategies before real learners are available, but only if the simulation reproduces where a particular learner succeeds and fails. The common approach asks a large language model to role-play a student, but a role does not model what this learner knows or will do next, so the model's own competence fills the gap. Simulated students perform at a level set by the model, differ little from one another, and seldom make the real learners' errors. We model the learner's behavior and recast student simulation as third-person prediction of the learner's next action. HACHIMI-II builds a student model from the learner's history, infers the learner's state for the current item or tutor turn, and compiles it into a behavior harness that constrains the next action. On three item-response datasets, the Wasserstein-1 distance between simulated and real student ability is 2.4--8.4$\times$ smaller than that of the strongest baseline. On two dialogue datasets, HACHIMI-II reproduces real student errors with the same knowledge type, locus, and mechanism 1.8--5.1$\times$ more often than the strongest baseline, and ablations trace the gains mainly to the explicit learner state. Predicting the learner makes capable models usable as simulated students.
articles.titleCn: HACHIMI-II：从角色扮演到学习者行为建模，实现忠实学生模拟
articles.abstractCn: 模拟学生使研究人员能够在真实学习者可用之前测试辅导系统和教学策略，但前提是模拟能够重现特定学习者的成功与失败之处。常见的方法是让大型语言模型扮演学生角色，但角色并不能模拟该学习者所知或接下来会做什么，因此模型的自身能力填补了这一空白。模拟学生表现出的水平由模型设定，彼此差异很小，且很少犯真实学习者的错误。我们模拟学习者的行为，并将学生模拟重新定义为对学习者下一步行动的第三人称预测。HACHIMI-II根据学习者的历史数据构建学生模型，推断学习者当前项目或辅导轮次的状态，并将其编译为行为约束装置，以限制下一步行动。在三个项目-响应数据集上，模拟学生与真实学生能力之间的Wasserstein-1距离比最强基线小2.4--8.4倍。在两个对话数据集上，HACHIMI-II比最强基线更频繁地重现真实学习者的错误，其知识类型、发生位置和机制分别为1.8--5.1倍。消融实验表明，这些改进主要归因于明确的学习者状态。预测学习者使能够的模型可用作模拟学生。

articles.title: Selective Reasoning for Typed Decision Models: When to Start, Read, and Stop
articles.abstract: Typed decision models need an interface that can use additional reasoning while retaining candidate outputs. We train a shared candidate-answer reader on a frozen Qwen3.5-4B backbone to unify direct decisions with on-demand, interruptible reasoning. The reader returns distributions from empty and partial reasoning prefixes. A benefit gate starts reasoning, a natural-state trigger requests explicit reads, and an entropy rule accepts acquired answers and cancels generation. Measurements distinguish answer-query work, generated output, and pipeline time. Across 768 questions from ProofWriter, LogiQA 2.0, and ARC-Challenge, accuracy rises from 70.96% for direct reading to 84.38%. Relative to 512-token terminal reading, accuracy improves by 7.29 percentage points with 2.25% more mean output work. Relative to 1,024-token terminal reading, pipeline time falls by 46.30% with an accuracy difference of -1.17 points. Exact-prefix controls isolate the saving from interruption, while read-scheduling controls distinguish reduced observation work from shorter response time.
articles.comment: 24 pages, 4 figures. Both authors contributed equally. Code and evaluation materials: https://github.com/binzheng-joey/selective-reasoning
articles.titleCn: 基于类型的决策模型的Selective推理：何时开始、阅读和停止
articles.abstractCn: 基于类型决策模型需要一种能够使用额外推理同时保留候选输出的接口。我们在冻结的Qwen3.5-4B主干上训练了一个共享候选答案阅读器，以统一直接决策与按需、可中断的推理。该阅读器从空推理前缀和部分推理前缀返回分布。一个效益门开始推理，一个自然状态触发器请求显式读取，一个熵规则接受获取的答案并取消生成。测量结果区分了答案查询工作、生成输出和管道时间。在ProofWriter、LogiQA 2.0和ARC-Challenge的768个问题中，准确率从直接读取的70.96%提升至84.38%。相对于512个token的终端读取，准确率提高了7.29个百分点，平均输出工作增加了2.25%。相对于1024个token的终端读取，管道时间减少了46.30%，准确率差异为-1.17分。精确前缀控制隔离了中断带来的节省，而读取调度控制区分了减少观察工作与缩短响应时间。

articles.title: Model What Matters: Decision-Guided Selective World Modeling for Language Agents
articles.abstract: Reinforcement learning provides a direct mechanism for optimizing task objectives in large language model-driven agents, but task rewards are typically sparse trajectory-level signals that only evaluate task success, without directly supervising action-conditioned environment transitions, leaving the model with limited explicit understanding of action consequences and environment dynamics. Recent work introduces auxiliary supervision through policy and world modeling co-training, yet typically treats complete environmental observations uniformly as world modeling targets, overlooking the varying decision relevance of observation content. We propose DGS-WM (Decision-Guided Selective World Modeling), a decision-guided policy-world modeling co-training approach for language agents. DGS-WM employs a Decision-Guided Observation Selection component that filters observation units with decision value as world modeling targets based on their support for subsequent policy responses, and a Confidence-Adaptive Weighting component that adaptively adjusts supervision strength according to the model's prediction confidence on selected targets. Together, these components form a decision-aware auxiliary world modeling loss, jointly optimized with the RL loss on the same policy model. Across multiple benchmarks covering single-hop/multi-hop question answering and interactive web tasks, DGS-WM achieves consistent improvements under different model scales and RL algorithms, demonstrating more stable and effective performance compared to full-observation world modeling methods.
articles.comment: Core implementation included as ancillary files
articles.titleCn: 关注关键模型：面向语言智能体的决策引导选择性世界建模
articles.abstractCn: 强化学习为优化大语言模型驱动智能体的任务目标提供了直接机制，但任务奖励通常是稀疏的轨迹级信号，仅评估任务成功，无法直接监督动作条件下的环境状态转换，导致模型对动作后果和环境动态的理解有限。近期研究通过策略与世界建模的协同训练引入辅助监督，但通常将完整的环境观测统一视为世界建模目标，忽视了观测内容的不同决策相关性。我们提出了DGS-WM（决策引导选择性世界建模），这是一种用于语言智能体的决策引导策略-世界建模协同训练方法。DGS-WM采用决策引导观测选择组件，根据其对后续策略响应的支持程度，过滤具有决策价值的观测单元作为世界建模目标，并配备置信度自适应加权组件，根据模型对选定目标的预测置信度自适应调整监督强度。这些组件共同形成决策感知的辅助世界建模损失，与策略模型上的RL损失联合优化。在涵盖单跳/多跳问答和交互式网络任务的多个基准测试中，DGS-WM在不同模型规模和RL算法下均实现了一致性提升，相较于完整观测的世界建模方法，展现出更稳定和有效的性能。

articles.title: J-tau: A Fully Localized Japanese Benchmark for Tool-Agent-User Interaction
articles.abstract: We present J-tau, the first publicly available Japanese benchmark for evaluating tool-using LLM agents in interactive customer-support scenarios. While tau-bench is widely used to evaluate LLM agents, it is English-centric and cannot evaluate agents in other languages. Existing multilingual extensions offer no public Japanese version and rely primarily on machine translation, leaving locale-specific entities such as addresses and currencies inconsistent with the target region. To enable reliable evaluation in Japanese, we carefully localize tau-bench through machine translation, entity adaptation, and human review. During this process, we also uncover and fix two flaws in the original tau-bench: invalid tasks and a score aggregation error that inflates certain models' results. Experiments show that J-tau yields fewer evaluation errors than a naively machine-translated counterpart and that our fixes resolve both flaws.
articles.titleCn: J-tau：一个完全本地化的日语工具-代理-用户交互基准
articles.abstractCn: 我们提出了J-tau，首个用于评估在交互式客户支持场景中使用的工具型大语言模型代理的公开可用日语基准。虽然tau-bench被广泛用于评估大语言模型代理，但它以英语为中心，无法评估其他语言的代理。现有的多语言扩展没有提供公开的日语版本，并且主要依赖机器翻译，导致地址和货币等特定区域实体与目标区域不一致。为了实现日语的可靠评估，我们通过机器翻译、实体适应和人工审核，对tau-bench进行了仔细的本地化。在此过程中，我们还发现了原始tau-bench中的两个缺陷：无效任务和导致某些模型结果被夸大的分数聚合错误。实验表明，J-tau比简单机器翻译的对应版本产生的评估错误更少，并且我们的修复解决了这两个缺陷。

articles.title: Sparse Autoencoders Are a Shared Coordinate System for Symbolic Matching
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) hold broad knowledge in one set of weights, but lack interpretability and trustworthy reasoning, especially in high-stakes use cases. A neuro-symbolic model, with its interpretable architecture and System 2 reasoning capacity, is a promising alternative if built at the scale of LLMs; however, its symbolic backbone is usually constructed with human effort, so existing neuro-symbolic models are bottlenecked by the scope of the symbol component and usually domain-specific. A data-driven method could instead build a larger symbolic system by aligning and merging existing ones. We target its first, foundational step: matching units across these heterogeneous systems. Our method, SAE-IDF, encodes a symbol in its native context into a sparse code with a sparse autoencoder (SAE), re-weights each dimension by its rarity and matches across systems. On 12 tasks across 6 kinds of symbolic system, SAE-IDF outperforms the same LLM's dense baseline on all tasks with Gemma-2-9B and all but one with Llama-3.1-8B, by up to 45 points, consistently across SAE layers and configurations. SAE-IDF is also interpretable: every dimension of the sparse code has a human-readable meaning, so each match decomposes into named concepts (features). Our work paves the way to a universal symbolic backbone.
articles.titleCn: 稀疏自编码器是符号匹配的共享坐标系
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在单一权重集上拥有广泛的知识，但缺乏可解释性和可靠的推理能力，尤其是在高风险应用场景中。神经符号模型凭借其可解释的架构和系统2推理能力，如果能够以LLMs的规模构建，将是一种有前景的替代方案；然而，其符号主干通常需要人工构建，因此现有的神经符号模型受限于符号组件的范围，并且通常是特定领域的。相反，数据驱动的方法可以通过对齐和合并现有模型来构建更大的符号系统。我们关注其第一步，即跨这些异构系统匹配单元。我们的方法SAE-IDF将符号编码为其原生上下文中的一种稀疏码，通过稀疏自编码器（SAE）对每个维度进行重新加权，并在系统间进行匹配。在6种符号系统中的12项任务上，SAE-IDF在所有任务中均优于Gemma-2-9B的同等LLM密集基线，在所有任务中均优于Llama-3.1-8B（除一项外），提升幅度高达45分，并且在SAE层和配置中始终如一。SAE-IDF也是可解释的：稀疏码的每个维度都具有人类可读的意义，因此每次匹配都会分解为命名概念（特征）。我们的工作为构建通用符号主干铺平了道路。

articles.title: DAGFormer: Global Topology Prediction for Transformer Cross-Layer Connections
articles.abstract: We propose DAGFormer, a Transformer language model whose cross-layer connections are planned by a jointly trained topology predictor. Beyond the residual connections in a standard Transformer, DAGFormer adds direct connections from earlier layers to later ones, and the predictor controls the strength of every connection based on input tokens. Unlike existing cross-layer routing architectures, which set each layer's connections separately, DAGFormer plans the routing of the whole model at once. On matched OLMo-2 pairs from 75M to 1B parameters, DAGFormer lowers WikiText-2 perplexity by 17% to 25% over the vanilla Transformer, and a 1B DAGFormer trained on 5B tokens outperforms the vanilla model trained on 10B. Against four routing baselines with the same data and budget, it reaches the lowest perplexity at 75M, 300M and 1B. The gain carries over to 13 commonsense, science, reading and math evaluation tasks (2.0 to 2.5 points higher mean accuracy at 300M and 1B) and to instruction finetuning (63% to 70% AlpacaEval win rate against the vanilla Transformer, leading every routing baseline), and under structured pruning DAGFormer degrades the least in five of six settings.
articles.titleCn: DAGFormer：用于Transformer跨层连接的全局拓扑预测
articles.abstractCn: 我们提出了DAGFormer，一种Transformer语言模型，其跨层连接由一个联合训练的拓扑预测器规划。除了标准Transformer中的残差连接外，DAGFormer还添加了从较早层到较晚层的直接连接，预测器根据输入标记控制每个连接的强度。与现有的跨层路由架构不同，后者分别设置每一层的连接，DAGFormer一次性规划整个模型的路由。在匹配的OLMo-2对（参数量从7500万到10亿）上，DAGFormer将WikiText-2的困惑度比普通Transformer降低了17%到25%，并且一个在5亿标记上训练的10亿参数DAGFormer优于在10亿标记上训练的普通模型。在与具有相同数据和预算的四个路由基线相比时，它在7500万、3亿和10亿参数上达到了最低困惑度。这种优势扩展到了13个常识、科学、阅读和数学评估任务（在3亿和10亿参数上平均准确率提高了2.0到2.5个百分点），以及指令微调（与普通Transformer相比，AlpacaEval胜率从63%提高到70%，领先所有路由基线），并且在结构化剪枝中，DAGFormer在六个设置中的五个表现最差。

articles.title: Divergent Paths: Learning an Outcome-Predictive Representation of LLM Agent Trajectories
articles.abstract: In this work, we reframe agentic trajectories as paths through a shared embedding space of actions and environmental observations. We show that successful and failed rollouts of the same task separate in this space, with simple per-task discriminators predicting held-out rollout outcomes at up to 0.95 AUROC across three agent benchmarks and three policy models. To exploit this signal across tasks, we introduce Precog-RM, a transformer-based model that meta-learns a representation in which outcome prediction can be performed in a few-shot setting. We show that Precog-RM generalizes to unseen tasks and models, and gives confident predictions of trajectory success long before termination. Deployed as an early stopping controller for Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) on Tau2-Bench, Precog-RM cuts training FLOPs by up to 47.3\% while maintaining performance comparable to baseline GRPO.
articles.titleCn: 殊途同归：学习一种预测LLM智能体轨迹结果的表达方式
articles.abstractCn: 在这项工作中，我们将自主轨迹重新定义为动作和环境观察的共享嵌入空间中的路径。我们证明，同一任务的成功和失败运行在这个空间中是分开的，简单的任务判别器可以在三个智能体基准和三种策略模型上以高达0.95的AUROC预测保留的运行结果。为了利用跨任务的信号，我们引入了Precog-RM，这是一个基于Transformer的模型，它元学习一个表示，在这个表示中可以在小样本设置中执行结果预测。我们证明Precog-RM可以泛化到未见过的任务和模型，并在终止之前就给出轨迹成功的自信预测。作为早期停止控制器部署在Tau2-Bench上的组相对策略优化（GRPO）中，Precog-RM在保持与基线GRPO相当的性能的同时，将训练FLOPs减少了高达47.3%。

articles.title: Are We Really Measuring Forgetting? Pitfalls in Evaluating Machine Unlearning for Multimodal LLMs
articles.abstract: As machine unlearning for multimodal large language models (MLLMs) rapidly advances, rigorous evaluation of its effectiveness becomes increasingly important. However, existing benchmarks largely inherit evaluation protocols from text-only unlearning and overlook the unique challenges of unlearning in multimodal settings. In this work, we identify three major pitfalls that may lead to misleading conclusions: the lack of heldout evaluation to distinguish genuine concept-wise forgetting from instance-wise overfitting, the reliance on synthetic, fine-tuned knowledge rather than real-world knowledge acquired during pre-training, and unfair method comparisons caused by applying the same training settings to different unlearning methods. To address these challenges, we introduce GEMMU (Generalizable Evaluation for Multimodal Machine Unlearning), a benchmark built on real-world knowledge and a principled evaluation protocol. Re-evaluating representative unlearning methods under GEMMU reveals substantial generalization gaps and challenges conclusions drawn from previous benchmarks. Our findings highlight the importance of rigorous evaluation for advancing multimodal machine unlearning and provide guidelines for future benchmark design.
articles.titleCn: 我们真的在衡量遗忘吗？评估多模态大语言模型机器再学习的陷阱
articles.abstractCn: 随着多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的机器卸载技术迅速发展，对其有效性的严格评估变得日益重要。然而，现有的基准测试主要继承了仅针对文本的卸载评估协议，忽视了多模态环境下卸载的独特挑战。在这项工作中，我们识别出可能导致误导性结论的三个主要陷阱：缺乏用于区分真实概念性遗忘与实例性过拟合的保留评估、依赖合成微调知识而非预训练期间获得的真实世界知识，以及因对不同卸载方法应用相同训练设置而导致的公平性方法比较问题。为应对这些挑战，我们引入了GEMMU（多模态机器卸载通用评估），这是一个基于真实世界知识和原则性评估协议的基准测试。在GEMMU下重新评估代表性卸载方法揭示了显著的泛化差距，并对先前基准测试得出的结论提出了质疑。我们的研究结果强调了严格评估对于推动多模态机器卸载技术发展的重要性，并为未来基准测试设计提供了指导方针。

articles.title: Twenty Days Later: A Pre-Registered Test of History-Based Forecasts of Brand Mentions in Gemini Answers
articles.abstract: Counts of which brands a large language model names are useful only if they hold long enough to act on. We test this with a pre-registered replication. The same 162 requests (54 questions in English, Estonian and Finnish about three software categories, four of twelve candidate brands per question, three repeats) were sent to gemini-3.1-pro-preview in three waves within about ten hours on 22 and 23 September 2026, and again on 13 October 2026, 20.3 days after the third wave, with identical request bodies. The plan and its decision rule were frozen, hashed and registered on OSF before the first call. The outcome is a lexical mention label per answer and brand, 648 per wave. The primary forecast, each brand-and-question cell's mention rate over the nine earlier answers, scored Brier 0.0281 and log loss 0.126, against Brier 0.0259 for the six-answer forecast of the 8-hour wave and a registered ceiling of 0.0559. It beat brand history (0.104), the overall rate (0.234) and a constant 0.5 (0.250) on both scores and in all nine question families (exact sign-flip p = 0.0039), so durability holds under the registered rule. A forecast frozen from the first wave alone scored 0.0599, 0.0587 and 0.0604 at horizons of 1.5 hours, 9.6 hours and 20.7 days. Of the 202 cells unanimous in the 8-hour wave, 194 were unchanged at D1 and none reversed. The latest wave alone was nearly as accurate as the pooled history (Brier 0.0292; pooled lower in 5 of 9 families, p = 0.28). Every answer reported the requested model version, and none issued a search query although search was enabled. A blind human check of 96 labels agreed with the rule on 94; both disagreements were adjudicated as rater omissions, so after adjudication the rule matched on 96 of 96. The test covers one model, one interval and twelve known brands, and estimates no decay rate.
