articles.titleCn: 二十天后：一项基于历史预测的Gemini Answers品牌提及的预注册测试
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型提及哪些品牌是有用的，前提是它们需要足够长时间才能采取行动。我们通过一项预先注册的重复实验来测试这一点。在2026年9月22日和23日约十个小时内，以三波形式向gemini-3.1-pro-preview发送了相同的162个请求（54个关于三个软件类别的英语、爱沙尼亚语和芬兰语问题，每个问题有四个候选品牌中的四个，重复三次），并在2026年10月13日，距离第三波20.3天后再次发送，请求体完全相同。计划及其决策规则在第一次调用前冻结、哈希并注册在OSF上。结果为每个答案和品牌的词汇提及标签，每波648个。主要预测是每个品牌和问题单元在九个先前答案中的提及率，得分为Brier 0.0281和log loss 0.126，而8小时波的六答案预测得分为0.0259，注册上限为0.0559。它在两个评分指标和所有九个问题系列（精确符号翻转p = 0.0039）中均优于品牌历史（0.104）、总体率（0.234）和常数0.5（0.250），因此持久性在注册规则下成立。仅从第一波冻结的预测在1.5小时、9.6小时和20.7天的视窗中得分分别为0.0599、0.0587和0.0604。在8小时波中一致的202个单元中，194个在D1时未改变，无一逆转。最新波单独的准确性几乎与汇总历史相当（Brier 0.0292；在9个系列中的5个中汇总得分较低，p = 0.28）。每个答案都报告了请求的模型版本，尽管搜索功能已启用，但无一发出搜索查询。对96个标签的盲法人工检查中，有94个与规则一致；两个分歧都被判定为评分者遗漏，因此裁决后规则在96个中的96个上匹配。该测试涵盖了一个模型、一个时间间隔和十二个已知品牌，并估计了无衰减率。

articles.title: PN-Mix: Pair-Norm Guided Mixed-Precision Key Cache Quantization for Efficient Long-Output LLM Inference
articles.abstract: Long-output inference in large language models suffers from severe KV cache memory and bandwidth bottlenecks. While KV cache quantization alleviates this issue, low-bit quantization (e.g., 2-bit) severely degrades model accuracy. Recent mixed-precision key-cache quantization methods mitigate this degradation by allocating higher precision to important key channels, but estimate channel saliency using only key statistics. Through attention logit perturbation analysis at the RoPE channel-pair level, we show that quantization errors in channel pairs with large query--key pair-norm products contribute significantly to logit variation. Based on this insight, we propose PN-Mix, a mixed-precision key-cache quantization method for RoPE-based decoder-only LLMs, which allocates higher precision to salient channel pairs identified once during the prefill stage and reused throughout decoding. Across standard reasoning, code-generation, and AIME benchmarks, PN-Mix with 2.26-bit average precision achieves comparable or better average accuracy than prior mixed-precision methods using 2.32--2.39 bits. Furthermore, in our Pareto sweep, PN-Mix degrades gracefully down to 1.5 bits, whereas the compared baselines exhibit sharper performance drops below 2.25 bits.
articles.titleCn: PN-Mix：基于对偶归一化引导的混合精度键缓存量化，用于高效长输出大型语言模型推理
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型的长期输出推理受到严重的键值缓存内存和带宽瓶颈的制约。尽管键值缓存量化可以缓解这一问题，但低比特量化（例如2比特）会严重降低模型精度。近期的混合精度键值缓存量化方法通过为重要的键通道分配更高精度来减轻这种退化，但仅使用键统计信息来估计通道显著性。通过在RoPE通道对级别进行注意力逻辑扰动分析，我们表明，具有较大查询-键对范数乘积的通道对的量化误差对逻辑变异有显著贡献。基于这一见解，我们提出了PN-Mix，一种基于RoPE的解码器仅LLM的混合精度键值缓存量化方法，该方法在预填充阶段识别显著通道对，并在解码过程中重复使用，为其分配更高精度。在标准推理、代码生成和AIME基准测试中，PN-Mix的平均精度为2.26比特，其平均精度与先前使用2.32-2.39比特精度的混合精度方法相当或更好。此外，在我们的帕累托扫描中，PN-Mix可以优雅地降级到1.5比特，而比较的基线方法在低于2.25比特时表现出更剧烈的性能下降。

articles.title: PA1-OPD: One-Step Prefix-Augmented On-Policy Distillation for Language Model Pretraining
articles.abstract: Knowledge distillation (KD) improves language-model pretraining by matching teacher distributions at corpus prefixes, but provides no direct supervision at contexts induced by student predictions. We introduce PA1-OPD, which augments corpus-path distillation with teacher feedback after one student-sampled transition per selected prefix. This expands the supervised states while retaining next-token prediction and corpus-path KD. Data-anchored roots support parallel sampling, and differentiable tree attention shares prefix computation without changing inference. In two continued-pretraining settings, full coverage improves held-out cross-entropy over KD across C4, PG-19, and Pile at every evaluated checkpoint. In Stage2, selecting the 10% of roots with highest student surprisal adds 48.85% to KD's Macro cross-entropy gain over next-token training. Gains remain when branch supervision excludes successor states already on the corpus path, supporting the value of feedback beyond observed contexts. Additional depth or breadth improves aggregate results at unchanged per-term supervision weight, with benefits varying by corpus. These findings support local student-induced supervision as a complement to pretraining distillation.
articles.titleCn: PA1-OPD：一种用于语言模型预训练的一步前缀增强在线策略蒸馏方法
articles.abstractCn: 知识蒸馏（KD）通过匹配语料库前缀上的教师分布来改进语言模型的预训练，但在学生预测所诱导的上下文中没有提供直接监督。我们引入了PA1-OPD，它通过在每个选定的前缀后添加一个学生采样的转换后的教师反馈来增强语料库路径蒸馏。这扩展了受监督状态，同时保留了下一词预测和语料库路径KD。数据锚定的根支持并行采样，可微分的树注意力共享前缀计算，而不会改变推理。在两个持续预训练设置中，完全覆盖在每个评估检查点都提高了C4、PG-19和Pile上的保留交叉熵，优于KD。在Stage2中，选择学生意外值最高的10%根增加了KD的宏观交叉熵增益48.85%，优于下一词训练。当分支监督排除已在语料库路径上的后继状态时，收益仍然存在，支持反馈的价值超越了观察到的上下文。增加额外的深度或广度在不改变每项监督权重的情况下提高了综合结果，其效益因语料库而异。这些发现支持局部学生诱导监督作为预训练蒸馏的补充。

articles.title: Moral Combat: Exploiting Moral Foundations Theory to Jailbreak LLMs
articles.abstract: Social psychology has long described how people can be persuaded to interpret a harmful act as moral. Recent research suggests that Large Language Models (LLMs) echo aspects of human psychology, from cognitive biases to social conformity. This raises a question with direct safety implications: can LLMs be moralized to bypass safety guardrails? We answer this question with a multi-agent framework grounded in Moral Foundations Theory (MFT). Given a harmful request that is initially refused, our agents diagnose which moral foundation (MF) the prompt is violating, identify a justifiable foundation under which the same request appears virtuous, rewrite the prompt accordingly, and reinforce it with generated precedents of comparable moral reframing. We evaluate our framework on harmful prompts from three well-known jailbreak datasets across five open-source and proprietary models. Our analysis reveals that models are highly susceptible to moralization, exhibiting high single-trial jailbreak rates with success increasing further under repeated attempts. We also find that safety benchmarks are imbalanced in the MFs they violate, concentrating on foundations toward which models already exhibit biases.
articles.titleCn: 道德之战：利用道德基础理论破解大型语言模型
articles.abstractCn: 社会心理学长期以来描述了人们如何被说服将有害行为解释为道德行为。近期研究表明，大型语言模型（LLMs）在认知偏差到社会认同等方面反映了人类心理的某些方面。这引发了一个具有直接安全影响的问题：LLMs能否被道德化以绕过安全护栏？我们通过一个基于道德基础理论（MFT）的多智能体框架来回答这个问题。对于一个最初被拒绝的有害请求，我们的智能体会诊断该提示违反了哪个道德基础（MF），识别一个可以证明的道德基础，在该基础上同样的请求看起来是道德的，相应地重写提示，并用生成的类似道德重述的先例来强化它。我们在三个著名的越狱数据集上的有害提示中，对五个开源和专有模型评估了我们的框架。我们的分析表明，模型很容易被道德化，在单次试验中表现出很高的越狱成功率，并且在重复尝试下成功率进一步提高。我们还发现，安全基准在它们违反的MF方面是不平衡的，集中在模型已经表现出偏见的那些基础。

articles.title: Who's Behind the Text? Robust Model Authorship Attribution
articles.abstract: As large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to generate text, their misuse has become a growing societal problem, with implications for academic misconduct, model distillation, and cyberattacks. For these reasons, Model Authorship Attribution (MAA), which identifies the source model of a given text, is important for promoting the responsible use of LLMs and improving AI safety. In practice, attribution systems must remain reliable beyond the distributions observed during training. They may encounter texts from unseen domains and writing settings, as well as generations from future versions of model families that were not available when the system was trained. However, existing MAA methods often exhibit substantial performance degradation under such distribution shifts. To address this challenge, we propose Authorship Tracing via Likelihood-based Attribution of Sources (ATLAS), which formulates MAA through source-conditioned text modeling rather than direct source prediction. ATLAS learns how text from each source family is generated and attributes a given text by comparing its likelihood under each learned source condition. We aggregate this likelihood evidence at the token level with clipping so that no single token dominates the decision. We further introduce MAABench, a broad MAA benchmark for evaluating practical OOD settings such as domain and version. Our experiments show that ATLAS consistently outperforms existing baselines across MAABench and OpenTuringBench. In particular, when both the generation domain and the model version change on MAABench, ATLAS achieves 74.27% accuracy, 9.00pp higher than the strongest baseline. Beyond MAA, ATLAS can also help identify distillation source models by measuring which source model a target LLM most closely resembles. Our extended experiments show that ATLAS recovers the known teacher of every distilled model we evaluate.
articles.titleCn: 谁在背后撰写文本？鲁棒的模型作者署名
articles.abstractCn: 随着大型语言模型（LLM）越来越多地用于生成文本，其滥用已成为日益严重的社会问题，涉及学术不端行为、模型蒸馏和网络攻击。出于这些原因，模型作者归属（MAA），即识别给定文本的来源模型，对于促进LLM的负责任使用和提升AI安全性至关重要。在实践中，归属系统必须在训练期间观察到的分布之外保持可靠性。它们可能会遇到来自未见过的领域和写作环境的文本，以及来自系统训练时不可用的模型家族未来版本的生成。然而，现有的MAA方法在分布偏移下通常表现出显著的性能下降。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了基于源似然归属的作者归属追踪（ATLAS），它通过源条件文本建模来构建MAA，而不是直接进行源预测。ATLAS学习每个来源家族文本的生成方式，并通过比较其在每个学习到的源条件下的似然来归属给定文本。我们在词元级别聚合这种似然证据并进行截断，以确保没有单个词元主导决策。我们进一步引入了MAABench，这是一个用于评估实际OOD（分布外）设置（如领域和版本）的广泛MAA基准。我们的实验表明，ATLAS在MAABench和OpenTuringBench上始终优于现有基线。特别是，当MAABench上的生成领域和模型版本都发生变化时，ATLAS达到了74.27%的准确率，比最强基线高出9.00pp。超越MAA，ATLAS还可以通过测量目标LLM与哪个来源模型最相似来帮助识别蒸馏来源模型。我们的扩展实验表明，ATLAS恢复了我们所评估的每个蒸馏模型的已知教师。

articles.title: INTACT: Inducing Latent Reasoning on a Frozen Backbone
articles.abstract: Latent reasoning replaces natural-language chains of thought with compact continuous "soft-token" representations, reducing the number of intermediate tokens that must be decoded autoregressively. We use a small external encoder to induce latent reasoning in a frozen backbone model. The encoder iteratively maps the backbone's hidden states to new latent blocks, constructing a latent reasoning prefix, after which the frozen model writes its remaining reasoning and its answer as text. Our method, INTACT, trains this encoder through distillation to reproduce the effect of written reasoning steps while keeping the model's behavior close to that of the frozen backbone, and then reinforces it on answer correctness. Across four frozen backbones from 1B to 8B, INTACT improves both GSM8K and average out-of-domain accuracy, including GSM8K gains from 75.8% to 79.3% on Llama-3.2-3B and from 77.6% to 79.7% on Qwen2.5-3B. It also reduces end-to-end latency per problem by 19% on Llama-3.2-3B and outperforms the evaluated latent-reasoning baselines at the 3B and 8B scales. Beyond the mathematics setting, the same recipe trained on a multi-domain corpus improves the frozen backbone on twelve evaluation benchmarks spanning mathematics, science, and commonsense, without task-specific adaptation.
articles.titleCn: INTACT：在冻结主干上诱导潜在推理
articles.abstractCn: 潜在推理用紧凑的连续"软标记"表示取代自然语言思维链，减少了必须自回归解码的中间标记数量。我们使用一个小型外部编码器在冻结的主干模型中诱导潜在推理。编码器迭代地将主干模型的隐藏状态映射到新的潜在块，构建潜在推理前缀，然后冻结模型将其剩余推理和答案作为文本写入。我们的方法INTACT通过蒸馏训练该编码器，以重现已写推理步骤的效果，同时保持模型行为接近冻结的主干模型，然后通过答案正确性对其进行强化。在从1B到8B的四个冻结主干模型上，INTACT提高了GSM8K和平均域外准确率，包括在Llama-3.2-3B上GSM8K从75.8%提高到79.3%，在Qwen2.5-3B上从77.6%提高到79.7%。它还在Llama-3.2-3B上每问题端到端延迟降低了19%，并在3B和8B规模上优于评估的潜在推理基线。超越数学领域，在多领域语料库上训练的相同配方在不进行特定任务适配的情况下，提高了冻结主干模型在涵盖数学、科学和常识的十二个评估基准上的表现。

articles.title: REWIND: Uncertainty-Guided Trajectory Repair for Test-Time Reasoning
articles.abstract: An early mistake in the generated reasoning can constrain all subsequent reasoning. Repeated-generation methods, like MCMC-based approaches, attempt to improve output quality by sampling multiple generations, but their effectiveness can be limited by randomly selecting where to regenerate. On MATH500 with Qwen2.5-Math-7B, we find that incorrect responses have substantially higher mean token entropy than correct responses, with an average within-question relative increase of approximately 112%, suggesting that entropy can signal reasoning errors. Motivated by this finding, we introduce REWIND, a training-free controller that uses entropy dynamics to propose targeted suffix regenerations. Across three model families and five benchmarks, REWIND outperforms all baselines, with gains of 0.51-10.00 percentage points over the strongest baseline. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of targeted, uncertainty-guided trajectory repair across models and tasks. Our code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/rewind-D310.
articles.titleCn: REWIND：不确定性引导的测试时推理轨迹修复
articles.abstractCn: 生成推理中的一个早期错误可能会限制所有后续推理。重复生成方法，如基于MCMC的方法，通过采样多个生成来尝试提高输出质量，但其有效性可能受限于随机选择重新生成的地方。在MATH500上使用Qwen2.5-Math-7B时，我们发现错误响应的平均token熵远高于正确响应，平均相对增加约为112%，这表明熵可以指示推理错误。基于这一发现，我们引入了REWIND，这是一种无需训练的控制器，它利用熵动态来提出有针对性的后缀重新生成。在三个模型系列和五个基准测试中，REWIND优于所有基线，相较于最强基线提升了0.51-10.00个百分点。这些结果表明，有针对性地、基于不确定性的轨迹修复在模型和任务之间都是有效的。我们的代码可在https://anonymous.4open.science/r/rewind-D310获取。

articles.title: $τ$-Emotion-Bench: Exposing the Interaction Fragility of LLM Agents through Real-World User Emotions
articles.abstract: In long-horizon tool-calling tasks, LLM agents can fail not only because of tool-use errors, but also because of ineffective interaction with users. Yet existing benchmarks largely assume cooperative and behaviorally stable users, leaving the effect of emotional variation on agent reliability underexplored. We introduce $τ$-Emotion-Bench, a ten-domain benchmark for evaluating tool-calling agents under controlled emotion-conditioned user interactions while preserving the underlying task objective. To scale both benchmark construction and agent training, we introduce Tracer, a scalable agentic data-generation pipeline that constructs grounded, policy-valid tasks and collects trajectories through an interactive agent--user--environment harness. By allowing dissatisfied users to terminate inefficient interactions, the harness provides an interaction-aware signal that filters trajectories with excessive user dependence and favors effective tool use. Experiments with two user simulators show that frontier agents remain unreliable, with substantial gaps between average task success and consistent task completion. Tracer-generated supervision consistently improves Qwen3 models across scales, generalizes to unseen domains, and transfers to $τ$-Bench and $τ$-Trait. Behavioral analyses further show that higher task success is associated with a better balance between tool execution and necessary user follow-up. Overall, $τ$-Emotion-Bench and Tracer provide a scalable framework for evaluating agent reliability under diverse user behaviors and improving tool-calling agents through interaction-aware supervision.

articles.titleCn: $τ$-情感基准：通过真实用户情感揭示大语言模型代理的交互脆弱性
articles.abstractCn: 在长时程工具调用任务中，大语言模型代理不仅可能因工具使用错误而失败，还可能因与用户交互无效而失败。然而，现有的基准测试在很大程度上假设用户具有合作性和行为稳定性，导致对情绪变化对代理可靠性的影响探索不足。我们引入了 $τ$-情绪基准 ($τ$-Emotion-Bench)，这是一个涵盖十个领域的基准测试，用于在控制情绪条件下的用户交互中评估工具调用代理，同时保留底层任务目标。为了扩展基准测试构建和代理训练的规模，我们引入了追踪器 (Tracer)，这是一个可扩展的代理数据生成管道，它构建基于事实、策略有效的任务，并通过交互式代理-用户-环境框架收集轨迹。通过允许不满的用户终止低效的交互，该框架提供了一个交互感知信号，过滤掉过度依赖用户的轨迹，并倾向于有效的工具使用。使用两个用户模拟器的实验表明，前沿代理仍然不可靠，平均任务成功率和持续任务完成率之间存在巨大差距。追踪器生成的监督数据能够持续提升不同规模的 Qwen3 模型，并泛化到未见过的领域，迁移到 $τ$-基准和 $τ$-特征。行为分析进一步表明，更高的任务成功率与工具执行和必要的用户跟进之间的更好平衡相关。总体而言，$τ$-情绪基准和追踪器提供了一个可扩展的框架，用于评估代理在不同用户行为下的可靠性，并通过交互感知监督改进工具调用代理。

articles.title: Evidence-Anchored Overdose Death Prediction from Death Investigation Reports
articles.abstract: Confirmation of overdose deaths in the United States is often delayed due to the complexities of certifying drug-involved deaths. Death investigation reports represent a rich but underutilized data source that could be used to predict whether a death is a suspected overdose (i.e., a death preliminarily identified as an overdose prior to the final cause and manner of death determination). We present an automated framework that classifies suspected overdoses from death investigation reports, while producing supporting explanations guided by expert knowledge. Through an expert-guided design process, we investigate 1) what type of explanations are best for model prediction performance, and 2) which architecture is better suited for this task: pipeline models that rationalize first and then predict, or self-rationalizing models that jointly predict and rationalize? Our experiments show that a pipeline model with explanations grounded in the input death investigation reports outperforms the other settings. Our best model also outperforms a rule-based system currently in deployment by 15%, while allowing expert interventions for final decisions.
articles.titleCn: 基于死亡调查报告的证据锚定药物过量死亡预测
articles.abstractCn: 在美国，由于药物相关死亡证明的复杂性，过量死亡确认往往延迟。死亡调查报告代表了一个丰富但未被充分利用的数据来源，可用于预测死亡是否为疑似过量（即，在最终死亡原因和方式确定之前，初步被识别为过量死亡的死亡）。我们提出了一种自动化框架，该框架从死亡调查报告中分类疑似过量死亡，同时根据专家知识生成支持性解释。通过专家指导的设计过程，我们研究了1）哪种类型的解释最适合模型预测性能，以及2）哪种架构更适合这项任务：首先进行推理然后预测的流水线模型，还是联合预测和推理的自推理模型？我们的实验表明，基于输入死亡调查报告的解释性流水线模型优于其他设置。我们的最佳模型在性能上比当前部署的基于规则的系统提高了15%，同时允许专家进行最终决策。

articles.title: GraphRAG-LTM: A Layered Threat Modeling Framework for Attacks on Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation
articles.abstract: Graph retrieval-augmented generation (GraphRAG) uses document-derived knowledge graphs to assemble evidence for large language model (LLM) answers. Its security depends on both the seed chunks retrieved for a query and the graph evidence assembled from them, yet attacks on this evidence path remain underexplored. We introduce GraphRAG-LTM, a Layered Threat Modeling framework that tests three nested levels of attacker access. BB Query uses ranking feedback to make query edits under a semantic-similarity constraint and demote relevant seed chunks. WB Query uses retriever gradients for the same objective. Graph-aware WB keeps the white-box adversarial query and deletes bridge triplets from the query-specific evidence graph, disrupting multi-hop evidence propagation through localized graph edits. Across datasets, retrievers, and LLM backbones, rank feedback alone reduces answer quality, gradient access strengthens query attacks, and bridge-triplet deletion further impairs supporting-fact retrieval. Further analyses show how seed retrieval and graph evidence jointly contribute to these failures.
articles.titleCn: 图检索增强生成攻击的分层威胁建模框架：GraphRAG-LTM
articles.abstractCn: 图检索增强生成（GraphRAG）利用文档衍生知识图谱为大型语言模型（LLM）答案组装证据。其安全性取决于查询检索的种子块以及从这些种子块组装的图证据，然而针对这一证据路径的攻击仍被忽视。我们引入GraphRAG-LTM，这是一个分层威胁建模框架，测试攻击者访问的三层嵌套级别。BB查询利用排名反馈在语义相似性约束下进行查询编辑并降级相关种子块。WB查询使用检索器梯度实现相同目标。图感知WB保留白盒对抗查询并从特定查询的证据图中删除桥接三元组，通过局部图编辑破坏多跳证据传播。在多个数据集、检索器和LLM主干上，仅排名反馈就降低了答案质量，梯度访问强化了查询攻击，桥接三元组删除进一步损害了支持事实检索。进一步分析揭示了种子检索和图证据如何共同导致这些失败。

articles.title: Typed Decision Models on Tabular Data
articles.abstract: Typed decision models are language models that answer a question with a fixed set of possible answers by returning a probability for each answer instead of generating text. We study them on tabular data and compare four decision models with three large language models (LLMs) on row classification, fact verification and anomaly detection. Every request is sent in its original form and under 21 types of rewrite that keep its content, such as renaming the options or writing the table in another format. The decision models perform as well as the LLMs at a lower cost. Three of them are also far more robust to how the question is formulated. No model we test is robust to how the table is organized. For every model, at least a third of the row decisions change under some rewrite of the table or the question. The decisions to which a decision model gives low probability are the ones most likely to change. Decision models are a practical choice for tabular decisions, but their robustness remains an open problem.
articles.titleCn: 基于表格数据的类型化决策模型
articles.abstractCn: 类型化决策模型是一种语言模型，它通过为每个可能的答案返回概率来回答问题，而不是生成文本。我们在表格数据上研究它们，并将四种决策模型与三种大型语言模型（LLM）在行分类、事实验证和异常检测任务上进行比较。每个请求都以原始形式发送，并在21种保持其内容的改写形式下发送，例如重命名选项或将表格以其他格式书写。决策模型在成本更低的情况下表现与LLM相当。其中三种决策模型对问题的表述方式也具有远超LLM的鲁棒性。我们所测试的模型均未对表格的组织方式表现出鲁棒性。对于每个模型，至少有三分之一的行决策会在表格或问题的某些改写下发生变化。决策模型给出低概率的决策最有可能发生变化。决策模型是表格决策的实用选择，但其鲁棒性仍是一个开放问题。

articles.title: A Unified Response Framework for Questions and Tutoring Dialogues
articles.abstract: Existing student models in educational applications largely focus on student responses to questions. However, as tutoring becomes more accessible at large scale, it is important to analyze dialogues between tutors and students, which may reveal fine-grained evidence on student knowledge. In this work, we propose a unified framework that models both student responses to questions and tutor-posed subtasks during dialogues on a shared item response theory (IRT) scale. We first identify mathematical subtasks in tutoring dialogues, rewrite them into self-contained questions, and identify the correctness of student responses to these subtasks. We then develop an IRT framework that estimates question/subtask difficulty from text, tracks students' evolving abilities across question-answering and dialogue interactions, and a novel method to leverages tutor moves between consecutive subtasks to regularize their difficulty values. We evaluate our framework on two real-world math education datasets containing both human- and AI-tutored dialogues. Results show that our framework outperforms strong baselines on both question difficulty prediction and response correctness prediction.
articles.titleCn: 面向问答与辅导对话的统一响应框架
articles.abstractCn: 现有的教育应用中的学生模型主要关注学生对问题的回答。然而，随着辅导服务的大规模普及，分析导师与学生之间的对话变得至关重要，这些对话可能揭示学生知识的细微证据。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种统一框架，该框架在共享的项目反应理论（IRT）量表上对学生的问答和对话中导师提出的子任务进行建模。我们首先识别辅导对话中的数学子任务，将它们改写成独立的自包含问题，并识别学生对这些子任务的回答是否正确。然后，我们开发了一个IRT框架，该框架从文本中估计问题的难度/子任务的难度，跟踪学生在问答和对话交互中能力的变化，并提出了一种新颖的方法，利用连续子任务之间的导师行为来正则化其难度值。我们在包含人类和人工智能辅导对话的两组真实世界数学教育数据集上评估了我们的框架。结果表明，我们的框架在问题难度预测和回答正确性预测方面均优于强基线模型。

articles.title: Retrieve What Helps, Only When It Helps: Agentic Reinforcement Learning for Selective Retrieval-Augmented Machine Translation
articles.abstract: Retrieving external knowledge can improve large language model (LLM) translation by providing supplementary information such as idiom interpretations and terminology. However, existing retrieval-augmented machine translation systems typically apply predefined retrieval strategies uniformly across all inputs. We argue that translation operates in a partial-evidence regime: LLM's parametric knowledge suffices for many inputs, while external evidence benefits a subset and usually supports rather than directly provides the desired translation. This creates two challenges: deciding when to retrieve and what evidence to acquire. We introduce Selective Retrieval-Augmented Translation (SRAT), an agentic reinforcement learning framework that learns when to translate directly or retrieve, what to retrieve, and how to integrate these decisions by optimizing final translation quality. To align evidence retrieval with downstream translation quality rather than simple semantic similarity, we further develop joint Plackett--Luce optimization and translation-quality contrastive training for retriever-training. Experiments on idiom, knowledge-intensive, and document-level translation with offline or online retrieval show that SRAT consistently outperforms never- and always-retrieve baselines, and quality-aligned retriever training provides further gains when similarity-based retrieval is insufficient. The results demonstrate the benefit of treating retrieval as a learnable translation action rather than fixed preprocessing.
articles.titleCn: 根据需要检索所需内容：具有选择性检索增强机器翻译的自主强化学习
articles.abstractCn: 检索外部知识可以通过提供成语解释和术语等补充信息来提升大型语言模型（LLM）的翻译效果。然而，现有的检索增强机器翻译系统通常对所有输入统一应用预定义的检索策略。我们认为翻译是在部分证据环境下进行的：LLM的参数化知识足以应对许多输入，而外部证据仅对部分输入有益，并且通常是通过支持而非直接提供所需翻译来发挥作用。这带来了两个挑战：决定何时检索以及获取何种证据。我们引入了选择性检索增强翻译（SRAT），这是一个代理强化学习框架，它学习何时直接翻译或检索、检索什么内容，以及如何通过优化最终翻译质量来整合这些决策。为了使证据检索与下游翻译质量保持一致，而非简单的语义相似度，我们进一步开发了联合Plackett-Luce优化和翻译质量对比训练来训练检索器。在成语、知识密集型以及文档级翻译任务中，采用离线或在线检索的实验表明，SRAT始终优于从不检索和总是检索的基线，而质量对齐的检索器训练在基于相似度的检索不足时能带来进一步提升。结果表明，将检索视为可学习的翻译动作而非固定的预处理步骤具有显著优势。

articles.title: Diagnosing and Correcting Reward Hacking in Verifiable Instruction Following
articles.abstract: Verifiable instruction-following benchmarks emphasize output-constraint satisfaction but can overlook whether responses meaningfully answer the underlying request, creating an evaluation blind spot. We show that frontier models can receive full credit for responses with little substantive answer content. Using the same verifier-based criterion as a training reward can induce reward hacking, as publicly released checkpoints exhibit higher constraint satisfaction but lower response quality after reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards. To address this reward hacking, we introduce CALIF, a lightweight method that augments verifier rewards with a calibrated likelihood-based bonus to preserve response quality. CALIF evaluates response likelihood under the request alone using the existing frozen reference policy, requiring no additional judge or learned reward model. Across models ranging from 1.7B to 8B in reasoning and non-reasoning modes, CALIF improves constraint satisfaction on IFBench while maintaining response quality near or above pre-RL levels. It also outperforms corresponding base policies in 40 of 45 model-metric comparisons across three rubric-based instruction-following benchmarks, demonstrating gains beyond training verifiers.
articles.titleCn: 诊断和纠正可验证指令遵循中的奖励破解
articles.abstractCn: 可验证的指令遵循基准强调输出约束满足，但可能忽略响应是否真正有意义地回答了底层请求，从而造成评估盲点。我们证明，前沿模型可以对内容实质性回答很少的响应获得满分。使用与训练奖励相同的基于验证者的标准可能导致奖励攻击，因为公开发布的检查点在经过可验证奖励的强化学习后，虽然约束满足度更高，但响应质量更低。为解决这种奖励攻击问题，我们引入CALIF，这是一种轻量级方法，通过添加校准的基于似然性的奖金来增强验证者奖励，以保持响应质量。CALIF仅使用现有的冻结参考策略，在请求下评估响应似然性，无需额外的裁判或学习到的奖励模型。在1.7B到8B推理和非推理模式下，CALIF在IFBench上提高了约束满足度，同时保持了接近或高于预强化学习水平的响应质量。它还在三个基于标准的指令遵循基准的45个模型指标比较中的40个方面优于相应的基线策略，展示了超越训练验证者的收益。

articles.title: One Block Ahead: Promoting Sampler State in Diffusion Language Models
articles.abstract: Block-diffusion language models denoise a whole block of token positions in parallel so each forward pass can emit many tokens. However, blocks are still denoised in strict sequence, a cost that within-block acceleration leaves untouched. Here, we investigate decoding blocks concurrently and propose One Block Ahead (OBA), a training-free decoding algorithm that denoises the next block alongside the current one. We demonstrate that for uniform-state diffusion LMs, where a block's denoising progress is not visible in its intermediate tokens, concurrent decoding is advantageous if the next block's tokens are promoted together with the corresponding sampler state, including the self-conditioning signal and the denoising time. We also derive a break-even criterion that relates the benefit of OBA to the relative cost of a paired-block forward pass. On DiffusionGemma, a state-of-the-art diffusion LM, OBA increases the tokens per forward pass by 42.3% (from 15.64 to 22.25) and the single-request denoising throughput by 16.3%, averaged over ten benchmarks, with a small accuracy regression.
articles.titleCn: 一步领先：促进扩散语言模型中的采样状态
articles.abstractCn: 块扩散语言模型并行地对整个块内的标记位置进行去噪，因此每次前向传递可以生成许多标记。然而，块仍然按严格顺序进行去噪，这一成本在块内加速中被忽略。在这里，我们研究并行解码块，并提出了一种无训练解码算法——提前一个块（OBA），该算法在当前块去噪的同时对下一个块进行去噪。我们证明，对于均匀状态扩散LM，其中块的去噪进度在其中间标记中不可见，如果将下一个块的标记与相应的采样状态一起提升，包括自调节信号和去噪时间，则并行解码是有利的。我们还推导出了一个盈亏平衡标准，该标准将OBA的效益与成对块前向传递的相对成本联系起来。在DiffusionGemma上，一个最先进的扩散LM，OBA将每次前向传递的标记数提高了42.3%（从15.64增加到22.25），并将单请求去噪吞吐量平均提高了16.3%，略有精度回归。

articles.title: Structure-Preserving Document-Level Data Augmentation via Discourse Parsing
articles.abstract: Data augmentation (DA) plays a vital role in improving model performance in low-resource or limited-supervision scenarios within Natural Language Processing (NLP). Existing DA methods, such as synonym replacement and back-translation, have demonstrated effectiveness on the word or sentence level; however, they frequently neglect discourse-level coherence and logical flow, which are essential for complex tasks dependent on inter-sentential relationships. In this paper, we propose a structure-preserving document-level data augmentation framework based on large language models (LLMs) and document-level discourse structure parsing. Our approach identifies rhetorical relations between sentence pairs and extracts key phrases, which are then replaced with semantically coherent but topically shifted content while preserving the original discourse structure. Experimental results on text summarization and question answering show that the proposed augmented data provides complementary supervision and improves combined-data training across the evaluated tasks. Comparisons with a standard RST parser and controlled ablations further support the proposed discourse representation.
articles.comment: 11 pages, 1 figure, 6 tables. Accepted at the 40th Pacific Asia Conference on Language, Information and Computation (PACLIC 2026)
articles.titleCn: 基于话语分析的文档级数据增强方法
articles.abstractCn: 数据增强（DA）在自然语言处理（NLP）领域中低资源或有限监督场景下对提升模型性能起着至关重要的作用。现有的数据增强方法，如同义词替换和回译，在词或句子层面已展现出有效性；然而，它们常常忽略篇章层面的连贯性和逻辑性，而这两者对于依赖句子间关系的复杂任务至关重要。在本文中，我们基于大型语言模型（LLMs）和篇章结构解析，提出了一种保留结构的文档级数据增强框架。我们的方法识别句子对之间的修辞关系，并提取关键短语，然后用语义连贯但主题有所变化的文本替换这些短语，同时保持原始的篇章结构。在文本摘要和问答任务上的实验结果表明，所提出的数据增强提供了互补的监督，并提升了跨任务的综合数据训练效果。与标准RST解析器的比较以及受控消融实验进一步支持了所提出的篇章表示方法。

articles.title: Towards Efficient Simultaneous Inverse Text Normalization with Pretrained Text-to-Text Language Model and Read-Tag-Write Policy
articles.abstract: Streaming Inverse Text Normalization (ITN) is vital for converting spoken-form outputs from streaming Automatic Speech Recognition into formatted written text. Existing streaming ITN methods rely on hybrid systems combining neural tagging with expert-crafted finite-state transducer rules, limiting scalability across domains and languages. While end-to-end models offer superior scalability by learning directly from data, standard encoder-decoder architectures are inherently non-streaming due to global attention. In this paper, we propose an efficient streaming end-to-end ITN system, adapting a pretrained text-to-text model to leverage its robust linguistic knowledge. To enable streaming, we introduce architectural adaptations, a specialized training strategy, a Read-Tag-Write decoding policy, and inference optimizations. Experiments on Vietnamese datasets show accuracy comparable to non-streaming baselines, outperforming hybrid methods while satisfying real-time latency requirements.
articles.titleCn: 基于预训练文本到文本语言模型和读-标-写策略的高效并行文本逆规范化
articles.abstractCn: 流式逆文本规范化（ITN）对于将流式自动语音识别的语音形式输出转换为格式化书面文本至关重要。现有的流式ITN方法依赖于结合神经标记和专家设计的有限状态转换器规则的混合系统，这限制了跨领域和语言的扩展性。虽然端到端模型通过直接从数据中学习提供了卓越的扩展性，但标准的编码器-解码器架构由于全局注意力机制而本质上非流式。在本文中，我们提出了一种高效的流式端到端ITN系统，通过调整预训练的文本到文本模型来利用其强大的语言知识。为了实现流式处理，我们引入了架构适应性调整、专门化的训练策略、读-标-写解码策略以及推理优化。在越南语数据集上的实验表明，其准确性与非流式基线相当，同时优于混合方法，并满足实时延迟要求。

articles.title: AgriJev: Efficient Agricultural Candidate Scoring with Multi-Scale Adapted Models
articles.abstract: Agricultural systems make decisions over heterogeneous entity types, textual judgments, and knowledge-question options. Generating a textual answer adds decoding and extraction steps to decisions that ultimately require a candidate choice. We introduce AgriJev, a family of adapted Qwen3.5 models at 0.8B, 2B, 4B, and 9B. A shared interface conditions on agricultural text, a judgment question, and candidate definitions, returning scores and relative probabilities in one forward call. We prepare source-aware training records and frozen evaluations from existing agricultural resources, retaining original groups and annotation provenance. Comparisons include original Qwen3.5 models and matched agricultural SFT models, both evaluated through native answer generation. Across 17 external test views, AgriJev-9B reaches 75.44% mean accuracy, exceeding the original and SFT generators by 5.89 and 3.79 percentage points. It outperforms the original generator on 13 views and narrows the mean gap to hosted Jev 1.13.0. On a fixed A100 workload, its median scoring latency is approximately half that of same-scale answer generation. Task-dependent gains and failures characterize a practical choice among agricultural model weights and inference contracts.
articles.titleCn: AgriJev：基于多尺度自适应模型的高效农业候选评分方法
articles.abstractCn: 农业系统需要对异构实体类型、文本判断和知识-问题选项进行决策。生成文本答案会增加解码和提取步骤，最终需要选择一个候选选项。我们引入了AgriJev，这是一系列经过适配的Qwen3.5模型，包括0.8B、2B、4B和9B版本。一个共享的接口基于农业文本、判断问题和候选定义进行条件化，在一个前向调用中返回分数和相对概率。我们准备了源感知的训练记录和来自现有农业资源的冻结评估，保留了原始分组和标注来源。比较包括原始Qwen3.5模型和匹配的农业SFT模型，两者均通过原生答案生成进行评估。在17个外部测试视图中，AgriJev-9B达到75.44%的平均准确率，比原始模型和SFT生成器分别高5.89和3.79个百分点。它在13个视图中优于原始生成器，并将平均差距缩小到1.13.0的托管Jev。在固定的A100工作负载下，其中位数评分延迟大约是同等规模答案生成的一半。任务相关的收益和失败特征了在农业模型权重和推理合同中的实际选择。

articles.title: What Does LALM Post-training Learn? Rethinking Audio Understanding and Reasoning Capabilities
articles.abstract: Post-training often improves the performance of large audio-language models on audio understanding and reasoning benchmarks. However, these improvements may reflect adaptation to specific question formats, such as multiple-choice questions, rather than genuine advances in audio understanding and reasoning capabilities. To investigate what LALMs actually learn from post-training, we conduct controlled experiments that disentangle improvements in audio understanding from adaptation to specific question formats. Across different models and post-training methods, we find that much of the reported improvement persists even without informative audio, but largely disappears when the question format changes. These findings suggest that post-training often teaches models to exploit task-specific textual cues and answer patterns rather than developing generalizable audio understanding and reasoning capabilities.
articles.titleCn: LALM 训练后学习什么？重新思考音频理解和推理能力
articles.abstractCn: 在训练后，大型音语言模型在音频理解和推理基准测试上的性能通常会得到提升。然而，这些改进可能反映了对特定问题格式的适应，例如选择题，而不是音频理解和推理能力的真正进步。为了研究音语言模型在训练后实际学到了什么，我们进行了受控实验，将音频理解的改进与对特定问题格式的适应分离开来。在不同的模型和训练后方法中，我们发现大部分报告的改进在没有信息音频的情况下仍然存在，但当问题格式改变时，这些改进大多消失。这些发现表明，训练后通常教会模型利用特定任务的文本线索和答案模式，而不是发展可推广的音频理解和推理能力。

articles.title: ActICL: Post-Training for Agentic Multimodal In-Context Learning
articles.abstract: Multimodal in-context learning (ICL) is an important capability of multimodal large language models (MLLMs). Its performance is closely tied to the demonstrations it uses, making demonstration retrieval a core problem for ICL. Common methods use fixed scoring methods to retrieve all the demonstrations at once, which may introduce redundancy and noise. Context-aware retrieval methods have emerged to address this problem by allowing incremental retrieval from a growing context. However, none of them lets the MLLM learn how to judge what new demonstrations it needs and then carry out progressive retrieval on its own. To this end, we introduce ActICL, which trains an MLLM agent to acquire and use an ICL context via tool-augmented reasoning. An ActICL agent analyzes its own information gaps during iterative reasoning and tool-use actions. Based on these gaps, it performs targeted retrieval to acquire a set of initial candidates. It can then use the existing context to further filter the candidates and refine the context, or it can iteratively perform a new retrieval. When the agent judges that the context is sufficient for the task, or when the resource limit is reached with the user request met, it sends the acquired context to an answering model, either the agent itself or another MLLM. We use a two-stage post-training procedure that jointly optimizes the agent's acquisition and answering. With an adaptive number of demonstrations, ActICL improves average performance by 11.6 percentage points over standard similarity-based retrieval across seven benchmarks and three MLLMs, and by 4.4 points compared to the strongest prior baseline. The contexts acquired by ActICL agents can also be used effectively by frontier models. When GPT-5.6-Sol performs 4-shot ICL, ActICL's contexts improve its performance by 3.5 points over standard retrieval, averaged over three benchmarks.
articles.titleCn: ActICL：自主多模态情境内学习的事后训练
articles.abstractCn: 多模态情境学习（ICL）是多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的一项重要能力。其性能与所使用的演示密切相关，使得演示检索成为ICL的核心问题。常见方法使用固定评分方法一次性检索所有演示，这可能会引入冗余和噪声。情境感知检索方法应运而生，通过允许从不断增长的环境中增量检索来解决这个问题。然而，它们都没有让MLLM学会判断自己需要哪些新的演示，然后自行进行渐进式检索。为此，我们引入了ActICL，它通过工具增强推理训练一个MLLM代理来获取和使用ICL情境。ActICL代理在迭代推理和工具使用过程中分析自身的信息差距。基于这些差距，它执行目标检索以获取一组初始候选。然后它可以使用现有情境进一步过滤候选并细化情境，或者可以迭代执行新的检索。当代理判断情境足以完成任务，或者当资源限制达到且用户请求满足时，它会将获取的情境发送给回答模型，无论是代理本身还是另一个MLLM。我们使用两阶段后训练程序，联合优化代理的获取和回答。通过自适应数量的演示，ActICL在七个基准和三个MLLM上比标准基于相似度的检索平均性能提高了11.6个百分点，与最强的先前基线相比提高了4.4个百分点。ActICL代理获取的情境也可以被前沿模型有效使用。当GPT-5.6-Sol执行4-shot ICL时，ActICL的情境在三个基准上的平均性能比标准检索提高了3.5个百分点。

articles.title: More Than Seeing: Vision as Scalable Anchors in Native Multimodal Pre-Training
articles.abstract: Native multimodal pre-training trains a single model from scratch on text and multimodal data, enabling it to understand both language and visual inputs. However, how visual signals shape scaling behavior and support capabilities beyond visual understanding remains unclear. We investigate this question through controlled visual-content ablations across model sizes and training budgets. Specifically, we replace image embeddings with content-free padding token embeddings. Retaining visual content improves text prediction on image-text examples without materially changing the lowest text-only loss at a given compute budget, the optimal balance of model size and training data, or aggregate language scores. The relative multimodal loss benefit grows approximately as a power law of compute. To test benefits beyond understanding images, we evaluate spatial reasoning from text descriptions alone. Both conditions improve with model and data scaling. During training of the largest model, visual gains are most sustained in localization, navigation, and symbolic planning, which involve maintaining object configurations or composing spatial updates; gains in spatial relations, geometry, and physical commonsense are less consistent. These findings identify visual content as a scalable anchor for multimodal learning, with benefits that extend beyond visual inputs while preserving aggregate language performance.
articles.titleCn: 超越视觉：在原生多模态预训练中，视觉作为可扩展的锚点
articles.abstractCn: 原生多模态预训练通过从文本和多模态数据中从头开始训练单个模型，使其能够理解语言和视觉输入。然而，视觉信号如何影响缩放行为并支持超越视觉理解的性能尚不清楚。我们通过跨不同模型大小和训练预算的受控视觉内容消融来研究这个问题。具体而言，我们用无内容的填充标记嵌入替换图像嵌入。保留视觉内容可以提高在图像-文本示例上的文本预测能力，而不会实质性地改变在给定计算预算下的最低纯文本损失、模型大小和训练数据的最佳平衡，或汇总语言得分。相对多模态损失收益随着计算量的增加近似呈幂律增长。为了测试超越图像理解的收益，我们仅通过文本描述评估空间推理能力。在两种情况下，随着模型和数据的扩展，性能均得到改善。在训练最大模型期间，视觉收益最持续地体现在定位、导航和符号规划中，这些涉及维持对象配置或组合空间更新；而在空间关系、几何和物理常识方面的收益则不太稳定。这些发现将视觉内容确立为多模态学习的可扩展基础，其收益不仅限于视觉输入，同时还能保持汇总语言性能。

articles.title: How Do LLMs Understand Legal Philosophy? Diagnosing Legal-Philosophical Reasoning in LLMs
articles.abstract: Legal reasoning is a fundamental capability for large language models (LLMs) to complete legal AI tasks such as legal judgment prediction. In legal practice, this reasoning is shaped by legal philosophy: a judge's view of the nature and sources of law guides how legal materials are interpreted and applied, so judges working from the same statutes and precedents can reach different judgments. Existing research has largely overlooked whether LLMs can understand legal philosophy and apply it in legal reasoning, an ability we call \textit{legal-philosophical reasoning}. To fill this gap, we introduce LePhilBench, a benchmark for evaluating the legal-philosophical reasoning of LLMs that comprises two benchmarking tasks and a dataset. The two tasks evaluate how well LLMs understand legal philosophy and how well they apply it in legal reasoning, respectively. The dataset is manually and meticulously constructed. Its test set contains 220 U.S. Supreme Court opinions. A law professor designed fourteen annotation questions on legal philosophy, and three law-trained annotators with formal training in jurisprudence answered all fourteen questions for every opinion, yielding 9,240 legal-philosophical labels. LePhilBench takes the first step toward exploring legal-philosophical reasoning in LLMs.
articles.titleCn: 大型语言模型如何理解法律哲学？诊断大型语言模型中的法律哲学推理
articles.abstractCn: 法律推理是大语言模型（LLM）完成法律AI任务（如法律判决预测）的一项基本能力。在法律实践中，这种推理受到法律哲学的影响：法官对法律本质和来源的看法指导着法律材料的解释和应用，因此，根据相同的法律条文和判例工作的法官可能会做出不同的判决。现有研究在很大程度上忽略了LLM是否能够理解法律哲学并在法律推理中应用它，我们称之为“法律哲学推理”。为了填补这一空白，我们引入了LePhilBench，这是一个用于评估LLM法律哲学推理能力的基准，它包含两个基准测试任务和一个数据集。这两个任务分别评估LLM理解法律哲学的程度以及它们在法律推理中应用法律哲学的能力。该数据集是经过人工精心构建的。其测试集包含220份美国最高法院的意见。一位法学教授设计了14个关于法律哲学的标注问题，三位接受过法学专业训练的标注员为每份意见回答了所有14个问题，从而产生了9,240个法律哲学标签。LePhilBench为探索LLM中的法律哲学推理迈出了第一步。

articles.title: ForkGRPO: Efficient Exploration and Fine-Grained Credit Assignment for Diffusion Language Models
articles.abstract: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) have advanced rapidly, yet strengthening their reasoning through reinforcement learning (RL) remains an open challenge. Any-order generation can suffer from entropy degradation, which narrows the reasoning paths available for exploration. Recent work mitigates this issue by applying standard GRPO with left-to-right generation. However, independently generating every rollout from the input prompt can leave alternative continuations from intermediate states underexplored, while trajectory-level advantages assign uniform credit to all tokens without distinguishing the contributions of individual reasoning segments. We propose ForkGRPO, an RL framework that couples efficient exploration with fine-grained segment-level credit assignment. It samples multiple continuations from high-entropy intermediate states along a reference trajectory, prioritizing textual boundaries and reusing shared prefixes. The continuations provide complementary learning signals: within-state group-relative advantages guide which continuations to reinforce, while Monte Carlo state-value differences indicate which reasoning segments improve expected outcomes. Among the evaluated architecture-preserving RL methods, ForkGRPO achieves the best performance on three of four benchmarks, while improving over the directly comparable JustGRPO by up to 1.2 percentage points and using up to 27.8% fewer generated tokens. ForkGRPO-Fast further achieves a $2.49\times$ training wall-clock speedup with negligible accuracy loss.
articles.comment: 20 pages, 5 figures. The first two authors contributed equally
articles.titleCn: ForkGRPO：扩散语言模型的效率探索与细粒度归因
articles.abstractCn: 扩散大型语言模型（dLLMs）发展迅速，但通过强化学习（RL）增强其推理能力仍是一个开放性挑战。任意顺序生成可能因熵退化问题而受限，从而缩小了可供探索的推理路径。近期研究通过应用标准GRPO进行从左到右的生成来缓解这一问题。然而，从输入提示独立生成每个回滚可能使中间状态下的替代延续探索不足，而轨迹级优势分配则对所有标记赋予统一信用，未能区分各个推理片段的贡献。我们提出了ForkGRPO，一个结合高效探索与细粒度片段级信用分配的RL框架。它沿着参考轨迹从高熵中间状态采样多个延续，优先考虑文本边界并复用共享前缀。这些延续提供互补的学习信号：状态内相对优势指导强化哪些延续，而蒙特卡洛状态值差异则指示哪些推理片段能改善预期结果。在评估的架构保持型RL方法中，ForkGRPO在四个基准测试中的三个上取得了最佳性能，相较于直接可比的JustGRPO提升了高达1.2个百分点，并减少了高达27.8%的生成标记。ForkGRPO-Fast进一步实现了2.49倍的训练时钟速度提升，且精度损失可忽略不计。

articles.title: Vision-Language Models Integrate Conflicting Evidence Like Biased Bayesian Observers
articles.abstract: Vision-language models must reconcile conflicting text and images. Prior work has characterized the resulting behavior in terms of modality biases--e.g., a "blind faith in text"--but why preferences vary across models, domains, and input conditions remains unclear. We develop a predictive account from a Bayesian perspective, positing that VLMs combine conditionally independent evidence from each modality with prior beliefs, subject to modality-specific biases. The resulting two-parameter cue combination model accurately predicts VLM preferences under unseen combinations of input degradation and transfers to new forms of unreliability without refitting. Separating evidence strength from integration bias explains how VLMs can follow text even while weighting visual evidence more heavily, reconciling reports of text and vision dominance under a single combination rule.
articles.titleCn: 视觉语言模型如同有偏见的贝叶斯观察者般整合冲突证据
articles.abstractCn: 视觉语言模型必须调和冲突的文本和图像。以往研究通过模态偏差（例如，“盲目信任文本”）来描述其行为结果，但模型、领域和输入条件偏好差异的原因仍不明确。我们从贝叶斯角度提出了一种预测性解释，假设视觉语言模型结合了各模态的条件独立证据与先验信念，并受特定模态偏差的影响。由此产生的双参数线索组合模型能够准确预测视觉语言模型在未见过的输入退化组合下的偏好，且无需重新拟合即可迁移到新的不可靠形式。将证据强度与整合偏差分离，解释了视觉语言模型如何在更重视视觉证据的同时遵循文本，从而在单一组合规则下调和了文本和视觉主导的报告。

articles.title: KoAGE: Do Large Language Models Know, Learn, and Coin Korean Neologisms?
articles.abstract: Korean neologisms arise through diverse mechanisms, a demanding test of language models beyond lexical memorization. To enable systematic evaluation, we introduce NeoTrace, an automated, rerunnable framework that collects and dates neologisms across genres. Its 4,271 entries support KoAGE, a cutoff-aware benchmark with three acquisition and two generation tasks---the latter, to our knowledge, the first to compare model coinages with attested neologisms under their original materials and community context. Across 21 models, lexical recall diverges from contextual inference: in a five-model temporal analysis, models define only 13-30% of cutoff-year words, yet can infer meaning from one usage. However, structural understanding remains limited: even correct definitions barely improve formation analysis of pre-cutoff neologisms. Given word-building materials, single models often follow human formation mechanisms, whereas multi-agent coinage favors abbreviation and depends on interaction framing. KoAGE thus separates what models know, learn from use, and coin.
articles.titleCn: KoAGE：大型语言模型是否知道、学习并创造韩语新词？
articles.abstractCn: 韩国新词的产生机制多样，这对仅依靠词汇记忆的语言模型提出了严峻的考验。为了实现系统性的评估，我们引入了NeoTrace，这是一个自动化且可重复运行的框架，用于收集和标注不同体裁中的新词。其包含4,271条条目，支持KoAGE，这是一个考虑截断时间的基准测试，包含三项获取任务和两项生成任务——据我们所知，后者是首次在原始材料和社区语境下比较模型创造的新词与已证实的新词。在21个模型中，词汇回忆与语境推断存在差异：在一个包含五款模型的时序分析中，模型仅能定义截断年份词汇的13-30%，但能从一次使用中推断出含义。然而，结构理解仍然有限：即使正确的定义也几乎无法改善对截断前新词的形成分析。在有构词材料的情况下，单个模型通常遵循人类的构词机制，而多智能体创造则倾向于缩写，并依赖于交互框架。KoAGE因此区分了模型所知、从使用中学习以及创造的内容。

articles.title: ELARSpeech: A 30K-Hour Dataset Across 675 Underrepresented Languages for Long-Tail Multilingual Speech Technologies
articles.abstract: Massively multilingual speech modeling has made remarkable progress in recent years, yet existing training resources and benchmarks still underrepresent much of the linguistic long tail. To address this gap, we introduce ELARSpeech, a large-scale multilingual speech resource comprising 30,202 hours of speech across 675 underrepresented languages, curated from the Endangered Languages Archive. Combining human-annotated and unlabeled recordings, the corpus spans diverse recording conditions, domains, and language families. Beyond corpus construction, our experiments show how ELARSpeech supports extending ASR and TTS capabilities to diverse underrepresented languages, with further benefits from pseudo-labeling unlabeled data. At the same time, our speech representation analysis reveals remaining limitations in transferring existing multilingual models to the linguistic long tail. Together, ELARSpeech provides both a resource and a testbed for extending multilingual speech technology further into the linguistic long tail. We publicly release the dataset, all trained ASR and TTS models, and the complete data construction pipeline to facilitate research on long-tail multilingual speech technologies.
articles.titleCn: ELARSpeech：一个包含675种代表性不足语言的30万小时数据集，用于长尾多语言语音技术
articles.abstractCn: 近年来，大规模多语言语音建模取得了显著进展，但现有的训练资源和基准数据集仍未能充分代表语言长尾中的大部分语言。为填补这一空白，我们推出了ELARSpeech，这是一个包含675种代表性不足语言、总时长30,202小时的超大规模多语言语音资源，这些语音数据来自濒危语言档案库。该语料库结合了人工标注和未标注的录音，涵盖了多样化的录音条件、领域和语言家族。除了语料库构建之外，我们的实验表明，ELARSpeech支持将语音识别（ASR）和语音合成（TTS）能力扩展到多种代表性不足的语言，并通过伪标签技术进一步提升了未标注数据的利用价值。与此同时，我们的语音表征分析揭示了将现有多语言模型迁移到语言长尾时仍存在的局限性。综合来看，ELARSpeech既是一个资源库，也是一个试验平台，旨在推动多语言语音技术进一步深入语言长尾。我们公开发布了该数据集、所有训练好的ASR和TTS模型，以及完整的数据构建流程，以促进长尾多语言语音技术的研究。

articles.title: The Sum of All Summaries: PROPALIGN for Graded Proposition Salience Evaluation
articles.abstract: Identification and ranking of salient propositions in documents is indirectly involved in many AI tasks, but few papers define proposition salience scores clearly, make diverse data available, or evaluate models directly on the task. This paper proposes PROPALIGN, a multiple-summary-based approach for propositional salience score estimation, and releases PROPALIGNBANK, an accompanying dataset for the method with 138K alignments of over 35K propositions. We compare several approaches to salient proposition extraction in English across a broad range of spoken and written genres, and demonstrate that naively asking models for judgments leads to inconsistencies. By contrast, graded, summary-based metrics are more stable. We further observe that while single models perform worse than humans, an ensemble of models incorporating linguistic features approaches manual annotation quality ceilings. In addition, analyses of the model outputs suggest insights into how models can extract salient information with and without the use of summaries.
articles.titleCn: 所有摘要的总和：用于分级命题显著性评估的PROPALIGN
articles.abstractCn: 在许多人工智能任务中，文档中显著命题的识别和排序发挥着间接作用，但很少有论文明确定义命题显著度分数，提供多样化的数据，或直接在任务上评估模型。本文提出了PROPALIGN，一种基于多摘要的命题显著度分数估计方法，并发布了PROPALIGNBANK，这是一个用于该方法的伴随数据集，包含超过35K个命题的138K个对齐。我们在广泛的口语和书面语类型中比较了几种英语显著命题提取方法，并证明，简单地要求模型进行判断会导致不一致性。相比之下，基于摘要的分级指标更加稳定。我们进一步观察到，虽然单个模型的性能不如人类，但结合语言特征的模型集成接近手动标注质量的上限。此外，对模型输出的分析提供了关于模型如何使用和不使用摘要提取显著信息的见解。

articles.title: Learning What to Keep: Transfer-Aware Personal Skill Learning from User Feedback
articles.abstract: User feedback enables LLMs to refine reusable personalized skills, but often mixes persistent preferences with request-specific corrections. Indiscriminately retaining both risks negative transfer, motivating selective retention at the level of individual requirements. We frame this challenge as selective transfer over atomic rules and propose SkillGrain, a framework for learning reusable personalized skills from user feedback. SkillGrain decomposes feedback into independently actionable rules, predicts their transferability, and retains only those suitable for future requests. To learn these decisions, we combine rubric-guided skill rewards with fine-grained credit assignment that separately evaluates rule content and retention decisions. We further jointly optimize skill induction and skill-conditioned generation through reinforcement learning, ensuring that learned skills support downstream personalization. We construct a benchmark spanning five personalized writing tasks to evaluate cross-request generalization. Experiments across three base models in both in-domain and out-of-domain settings show that SkillGrain achieves the best overall average performance among competing methods.
articles.titleCn: 学习保留什么：基于用户反馈的迁移感知个人技能学习
articles.abstractCn: 用户反馈能够帮助大型语言模型优化可复用的个性化技能，但通常会将持久性偏好与特定请求的修正混在一起。不加区分地保留两者可能导致负迁移，因此需要在个体需求层面进行选择性保留。我们将这一挑战定义为原子规则上的选择性迁移，并提出SkillGrain框架，该框架从用户反馈中学习可复用的个性化技能。SkillGrain将反馈分解为可独立操作的规则，预测其迁移能力，并仅保留适合未来请求的规则。为了学习这些决策，我们结合了评分指导的技能奖励与细粒度的信用分配，分别评估规则内容和保留决策。此外，我们通过强化学习联合优化技能归纳和技能条件生成，确保学习到的技能支持下游个性化。我们构建了一个涵盖五个个性化写作任务的基准，用于评估跨请求泛化能力。在领域内和领域外环境下，针对三个基础模型的实验表明，SkillGrain在竞争方法中实现了最佳的平均性能。

articles.title: Evaluating Compressed Memory: Dependence, Utility, and Content Benefit
articles.abstract: Does a language model answer better because its compressed memory contains useful document information? Replacing memory vectors with zeros can lower a trained model's score without showing that it outperforms a model trained without memory. We combine zeroing with separately trained models that cannot access stored text or receive the same constant input for every document. Across nine systems, some models rely on memory yet perform worse than the trained alternative. For example, in experiments that predict states in generated stories, zeroing memory worsens a model's prediction loss, yet a model trained without memory achieves lower loss than the original model with intact memory. On TriviaQA, giving xRAG memory from another question's passage raises F1, which measures word overlap with accepted answers, from 19.38 without a document to 24.78. Its effect on how often outputs contain an accepted answer is statistically uncertain. The question's retrieved passage scores higher still (29.88 F1). Thus a gain over no document alone does not establish that the gain requires the question's passage. Evaluations must therefore specify the comparison model, absolute performance, and generation and scoring conditions.
articles.titleCn: 评估压缩内存：依赖性、效用和内容收益
articles.abstractCn: 语言模型的回答是否更好，是因为其压缩的内存中包含了有用的文档信息？用零替换内存向量会降低训练模型的得分，却无法证明它优于未经记忆训练的模型。我们将零替换与分别训练且无法访问存储文本或为每个文档接收相同常量输入的模型相结合。在九个系统中，一些依赖内存的模型表现却不如无记忆训练的替代模型。例如，在预测生成故事状态的实验中，零替换内存会恶化模型的预测损失，而未经记忆训练的模型却实现了比原始完整内存模型更低的损失。在TriviaQA中，从另一个问题的段落中为xRAG提供内存将F1（衡量与接受答案的词重叠度）从无文档的19.38提高到24.78。其对输出包含接受答案频率的影响在统计上不确定。被检索的问题段落得分更高（F1为29.88）。因此，仅优于无文档的增益并不能证明该增益需要问题的段落。因此，评估必须明确比较模型、绝对性能以及生成和评分条件。

articles.title: Beyond Corrected Actions: Training LLM Agents on Textual Critiques
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for multi-turn agentic tasks that require interactions with users and environments over extended sequences of actions. A common approach to improving LLM agents is to use more capable expert models to provide training supervision, either by behavior cloning the expert's trajectories or by using the expert to correct the actions in trajectories generated by the weaker student model. However, expert LLMs can provide richer supervision than actions alone: they can directly generate textual critique that explain why specific actions are incorrect. We study whether training on such feedback benefits LLM agents and propose Critique-Augmented Agentic Fine-Tuning (CAFT), a framework that elicits textual expert feedback on student-generated trajectories. For each incorrect action, the expert yields both a corrected action and a textual critique explaining the student's mistake--which we then use as the training target for fine-tuning. Across four student models from the Nemotron 3 and Gemma 4 families on the agentic domains $τ^2$-Bench Airline+Retail and WebShop, adding critiques to action-level supervision improves performance by 8% on average over action-only distillation. Additionally, CAFT checkpoints can also provide a better warm start for reinforcement learning than expert-trajectory distillation. Our results demonstrate that textual critiques can strengthen supervision for multi-turn LLM agents.
articles.titleCn: 超越纠正行为：在文本评论上训练大型语言模型代理
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地用于需要与用户和环境在长时间序列动作中进行交互的多回合代理任务。改进LLM代理的一种常见方法是使用更强大的专家模型提供训练监督，这可以通过行为克隆专家的轨迹或使用专家来纠正弱学生模型生成的轨迹中的动作来实现。然而，专家LLM可以提供比单独动作更丰富的监督：它们可以直接生成文本批评，解释为什么特定动作是错误的。我们研究了基于此类反馈训练是否有利于LLM代理，并提出了批评增强代理微调（CAFT）框架，该框架在学生生成的轨迹上获取文本专家反馈。对于每个错误动作，专家都会提供一个修正动作和一个解释学生错误的文本批评——我们将其用作微调的训练目标。在Nemotron 3和Gemma 4系列的四个学生模型上，针对代理领域τ²-Bench Airline+Retail和WebShop，将批评添加到动作级监督平均比仅动作蒸馏提高了8%。此外，CAFT检查点还可以为强化学习提供更好的热启动，优于专家轨迹蒸馏。我们的结果表明，文本批评可以增强多回合LLM代理的监督。

articles.title: Seeing, Maintaining, and Learning: The Evolution of Multimodal Agent Memory
articles.abstract: Multimodal models and agents have emerged to enable AI systems to learn from and interact with the real world more like humans by integrating information across multiple modalities. However, enabling multimodal agents to continually acquire useful information from complex, heterogeneous multimodal data remains a significant challenge as they move toward long-horizon tasks and lifelong settings. Addressing this challenge requires effective memory mechanisms that can maintain continuity across sessions, adapt to changing users and environments, and refine memory-management policies through accumulated experience. We introduce a two-axis analytical framework for multimodal agent memory structured around two key questions: how multimodal information is formed and represented (Axis I, Formation and Representation), and how its management adapts with accumulated experience (Axis II, Memory Management). Axis I, Formation and Representation, characterizes what information is retained and how it is encoded (e.g., modality-specific embeddings, textual and structured records, latent and parametric representations) to support subsequent reasoning and action. Axis II, Memory Management, distinguishes three tiers: T1 Static Memory reuses fixed memory; T2 Dynamic Memory updates memory through a stable policy; and T3 Self-Evolving Memory updates memory through an evolving policy. Based on this framework, we synthesize recurring design patterns and derive principles for balancing source fidelity with abstraction, maintaining temporal validity and provenance, grounding memory use in recoverable evidence, and evolving memory policies over time. Furthermore, we discuss the challenges and potential future directions for the memory mechanism of multimodal agents.
articles.titleCn: 看见、维持与学习：多模态智能体记忆的演化
articles.abstractCn: 多模态模型和智能体应运而生，通过整合多模态信息，使AI系统能够更像人类地学习并与现实世界互动。然而，随着多模态智能体朝着长时程任务和终身学习环境发展，让它们持续从复杂异构的多模态数据中获取有用信息仍然是一个重大挑战。应对这一挑战需要有效的记忆机制，这些机制能够在会话间保持连续性，适应变化用户和环境，并通过积累经验不断优化记忆管理策略。我们提出了一种围绕两个关键问题的双轴分析框架来构建多模态智能体记忆：多模态信息如何形成和表示（轴I，形成与表示），以及其管理如何随经验积累而适应（轴II，记忆管理）。轴I，形成与表示，描述了保留何种信息以及如何编码这些信息（例如，模态特定嵌入、文本和结构化记录、潜空间和参数化表示），以支持后续推理和行动。轴II，记忆管理，区分了三个层级：T1静态记忆重用固定记忆；T2动态记忆通过稳定策略更新记忆；T3自进化记忆通过进化策略更新记忆。基于此框架，我们综合了反复出现的设计模式，并推导出平衡源信息保真度与抽象、保持时间有效性和来源、将记忆使用建立在可恢复证据之上、以及随时间进化记忆策略的原则。此外，我们还讨论了多模态智能体记忆机制面临的挑战和潜在的未来方向。

articles.title: Tail Competition Explains Scaling in Best-of-N Sampling for Verifiable Problems
articles.abstract: Best-of-N sampling is a simple inference-time scaling strategy for large language models, yet its behavior under incomplete reward models remains poorly understood. We study Best-of-N as a competition between the extreme reward tails of correct and incorrect responses. This view shows that success depends not only on the probability of sampling a correct response, but also on whether correct responses dominate incorrect ones in the upper tail. Using extreme value theory, we characterize three asymptotic regimes: correct-tail-dominant, incorrect-tail-dominant, and critical explaining both monotonic gains and reward-hacking-induced degradation. We further derive finite-sample scaling laws for representative reward distributions, showing that, under Gaussian rewards, incorrect responses with sufficiently large variance can dominate selection even when their mean reward is lower. Unlike oracle selection, convergence with an incomplete selector can be polynomial rather than exponential. Finally, we propose a lightweight tail-tension criterion to estimate when additional sampling may become harmful. Experiments on synthetic data and real reward model scores are consistent with the theoretically predicted regimes, scaling laws, and diagnostic behavior, suggesting that tail competition provides a unified lens on Best-of-N sampling for verifiable problems.
articles.titleCn: 尾竞争解释了可验证问题中最佳N选一采样中的规模效应
articles.abstractCn: N选最优采样是一种针对大型语言模型的简单推理时扩展策略，但其在不完整的奖励模型下的行为仍缺乏深入理解。我们研究N选最优采样，将其视为正确和错误响应的极端奖励尾部的竞争。这种观点表明，成功不仅取决于采样正确响应的概率，还取决于正确响应是否在高端尾部主导错误响应。利用极值理论，我们刻画了三种渐近状态：正确尾部主导、错误尾部主导和临界状态，解释了单调增长和奖励攻击诱导的退化。我们进一步推导了代表性奖励分布的有限样本扩展定律，表明在正态奖励下，具有足够大方差的错误响应即使在平均奖励较低时也能主导选择。与神谕选择不同，使用不完整的选择器时的收敛可以是多项式而非指数。最后，我们提出了一种轻量级的尾部张力准则，用于估计何时额外的采样可能变得有害。在合成数据和真实奖励模型分数上的实验结果与理论预测的状态、扩展定律和诊断行为一致，表明尾部竞争为可验证问题的N选最优采样提供了一个统一的视角。

articles.title: VLX-Go: Robust Embodied Tracking through Multi-Stage Learning and On-Policy Refinement
articles.abstract: Embodied visual tracking requires a robot to identify a designated target from visual observations and control its own motion to follow that target through an environment. Following an isolated person is a comparatively simple demonstration of embodied visual tracking, but following the intended person among distractors remains challenging. Existing methods exhibit a substantial drop in success from single-target to distractor tracking, motivating a focus on the shared spaces that person-following robots must navigate. We present \method{}, a vision--language waypoint policy built around the hypothesis that visual and language representations should be aligned before tracking-specific motion is learned. The policy combines complementary frozen visual encoders, multiscale temporal context, a transformer backbone, and a lightweight head for robot-centric waypoint prediction. Its training progresses through vision--language alignment, multimodal reasoning mid-training, and tracking specialization on 19,532 oracle episodes. Compared with 41.54\% distractor-tracking success for our earlier OmTrackVLA model, the complete multi-stage recipe achieves 55.80\%. We then explore on-policy refinement using filtered oracle labels for states visited by the policy. This preliminary study adds 2.42 percentage points of distractor-tracking success, reaching 58.22\%, while reducing collision rate by 1.99 pts. The final policy records the highest distractor- and ambiguous-tracking success rates among the compared methods. These results support staged multimodal learning as a promising direction for tracking among distractors and motivate further study of on-policy refinement for person following in shared spaces.
articles.titleCn: VLX-Go：通过多阶段学习和在线策略优化实现鲁棒具身追踪
articles.abstractCn: 具身视觉追踪要求机器人从视觉观测中识别指定目标，并通过控制自身运动在环境中跟随该目标。跟踪孤立的人是具身视觉追踪的一种相对简单的演示，但在干扰者中跟随目标人仍然具有挑战性。现有方法从单目标追踪到干扰者追踪的成功率显著下降，这促使人们关注人跟随机器人必须导航的共同空间。我们提出了\method{}，一种基于假设的视觉-语言航点策略，该假设认为在学习追踪特定运动之前，视觉和语言表示应该进行对齐。该策略结合了互补的冻结视觉编码器、多尺度时间上下文、Transformer主干和轻量级头用于机器人中心的航点预测。其训练过程通过视觉-语言对齐、训练中的多模态推理以及在19,532个神谕片段上的追踪专门化进行。与我们的早期OmTrackVLA模型41.54%的干扰者追踪成功率相比，完整的多阶段配方达到了55.80%。然后我们探索了使用策略访问的状态的过滤神谕标签进行策略上的优化。这项初步研究增加了2.42个百分点干扰者追踪成功率，达到58.22%，同时将碰撞率降低了1.99个百分点。最终策略在比较方法中记录了最高的干扰者和模糊追踪成功率。这些结果支持分阶段多模态学习作为干扰者中追踪的潜在方向，并激励对共享空间中人跟随的策略优化的进一步研究。

articles.title: Steering Vectors for Competing Ethical Frameworks Are Interchangeable: A Competing-Target Test for Activation Steering
articles.abstract: Activation steering adds a vector to a model's hidden states to control a named behaviour. A gain on that behaviour, however, does not show that the vector controls it directly: it may act through a component shared with neighbouring behaviours, which unsteered and random baselines cannot separate. We introduce the competing-target test: a vector is compared with the vector built the same way for a competing target, and an equivalence test states when their difference is below a useful margin. We apply it in open-weight models to vectors for Kantian deontology, which judges an act by the rule it follows, and act utilitarianism, which judges it by the welfare it produces. On held-out situations, prompting a framework raises its score and lowers the other's, whereas vectors for either framework move both scores alike, and none reaches the margin. The two vectors share most of their direction, a request to apply some framework; the same construction separates an optimistic from a pessimistic tone, whose vectors share much less. What a vector shares with its competitors therefore sets what it controls: steering a perspective can deliver a mixture, and measuring a disposition can measure its neighbours, unless tested against the competing target.
articles.titleCn: 竞争性伦理框架的导引向量是可互换的：激活导引的竞争目标测试
articles.abstractCn: 激活引导向模型隐藏状态中添加一个向量以控制特定行为。然而，该行为上的增益并不表明该向量直接控制它：它可能通过与其他邻近行为共享的组件起作用，而未引导和随机基线无法区分这一点。我们引入了竞争目标测试：将一个向量与以相同方式构建的竞争目标的向量进行比较，当它们的差异低于有用边界时，等价测试会声明其等价。我们将其应用于开放权重模型，用于康德义务论和行动功利主义的向量，前者根据规则判断行为，后者根据行为产生的福利判断。在保留情况下，提示一个框架会提高其分数并降低另一个框架的分数，而任一框架的向量会同等影响两个分数，且均未达到边界。这两个向量大部分方向相同，即要求应用某个框架；相同的构建方式可以区分乐观和悲观语气，其向量共享的方向较少。因此，一个向量与其竞争者共享的内容决定了它所控制的内容：引导视角可能会产生混合效果，而测量一种倾向可能会测量其邻近部分，除非通过竞争目标进行测试。

articles.title: Where to Start, How to Move: Analyzing Curricula under GRPO for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
articles.abstract: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) provides no reward-relative learning signal when all rollouts receive identical rewards. In long-horizon tasks that require multiple interactions, rewards are given only upon successful task completion, making all-fail groups common early in training and limiting opportunities to practice later steps. Guide Assisted GRPO replays a successful reference prefix before the learner continues. We study how initial positions, handoff units, and movement rules affect unassisted task completion. Across three model sizes on BFCL, starting near completion is more effective under a fixed turn-level threshold rule. Finer handoffs alone do not consistently help, but outcome-informed tool-call selection outperforms GRPO on trained and untrained task categories. Guided starts also improve AppWorld success on both evaluation splits. These findings highlight where learning starts and how starting positions move as key curriculum choices.
articles.comment: 7 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables. Minchan Kim and Sungho Bae contributed equally
articles.titleCn: 从何处开始，如何前进：分析适用于长时程大型语言模型代理的GRPO课程
articles.abstractCn: 组相对策略优化（GRPO）在所有 rollout 获得相同奖励时无法提供与奖励相对的学习信号。在需要多次交互的长时程任务中，奖励仅在任务成功完成时给予，导致训练早期普遍存在所有失败组，从而限制了后续步骤的练习机会。引导辅助的 GRPO 在学习者继续之前会重放一个成功的参考前缀。我们研究了初始位置、交接单元和运动规则如何影响无辅助任务完成。在 BFCL 的三种模型尺寸上，在固定的回合级阈值规则下，从接近完成处开始更为有效。仅通过更精细的交接并不能始终提供帮助，但基于结果的工具调用选择在训练和未训练的任务类别上都优于 GRPO。引导式起始也提高了 AppWorld 在两个评估分割上的成功率。这些发现突出了学习的起始点和起始位置如何移动作为关键课程选择。

articles.title: Target-Token Asymmetry Can Masquerade As Depth Specialization
articles.abstract: Layer-ablation studies often perturb early or late layers of a language model, compare the damage to prediction on two corpora, and read a larger early-layer effect on one corpus as early-layer specialization for its task. Such a comparison averages over the tokens that each corpus asks the model to predict, and these target tokens differ: math solutions, for example, ask for far more whitespace and numbers than encyclopedia prose. We show that this difference can create the appearance of depth specialization. We split a cross-corpus early--late damage interaction by target-token type and recompute it under a target mixture shared by both corpora. Between GSM8K and Wikitext, a positive interaction replicates across five model instances. In the three fully decomposed models, only whitespace has a positive interaction. Removing whitespace reverses the pooled effect in all three, and matching the full target mixture reverses it in two. The diagnosis holds under position matching, adversarial reassignment of token types, and a continuous readout. The risk can also be anticipated from the tokenizer alone. A screen computed before any model runs places every held-out pair it scored in the region its label predicts, and on the pairs it rates at high or medium risk, removing whitespace reverses every positive pooled estimate. A smaller content-word effect one token ahead follows the share of content targets that the unablated model already predicts. A cross-corpus depth effect therefore supports an interpretation of task specialization only after the target-token mixture is reported, the effect is decomposed by token type, and a mixture-matched summary keeps its sign.
articles.titleCn: 目标-标记不对称性可能伪装成深度专业化
articles.abstractCn: 层剪裁研究通常扰动语言模型的早期或晚期层，比较对两个语料库预测造成的损害，并将一个语料库上较大的早期层效应解读为其任务上的早期层专门化。这种比较平均了每个语料库要求模型预测的标记，而目标标记存在差异：例如，数学解决方案要求比百科文本多得多的空格和数字。我们表明这种差异可能造成深度专门化的假象。我们将跨语料库的早期-晚期损害交互按目标标记类型进行拆分，并在两个语料库共享的目标混合下重新计算。在GSM8K和Wikitext之间，一个正向交互在五个模型实例中重复出现。在三个完全分解的模型中，只有空格具有正向交互。移除空格逆转了所有三个模型中的汇总效应，而匹配完整目标混合在两个模型中逆转了该效应。诊断结果在位置匹配、标记类型对抗性重新分配和连续读出下均成立。仅从分词器即可预见这种风险。在模型运行前计算的屏幕将每个被其标签预测的得分对放置在相应区域，在它评为高或中等风险的配对中，移除空格逆转了所有正向汇总估计。一个较小的内容词效应（提前一个标记）遵循未剪裁模型已预测的内容目标份额。因此，跨语料库的深度效应只有在目标标记混合被报告、效应按标记类型分解、混合匹配的汇总保持其符号后，才能支持任务专门化的解释。

articles.title: Counterfactual Gate-Support Decomposition: Separating Selection from Redistribution in Training-Data Filtering
articles.abstract: A training-data quality gate changes both which examples survive within regions of the input space and how training mass is distributed across those regions, so a gate-versus-random comparison does not isolate these mechanisms. We introduce Counterfactual Gate-Support Decomposition (CGSD), a four-arm, budget-matched design that crosses gate eligibility with support distribution and decomposes the observed gate effect into within-support selection, between-support redistribution, and their interaction. The practical constraint is finite-pool realizability: we characterize mass and token-assembly conditions under which the required arms can be constructed, together with a support-extinction case in which the ordinary design is undefined. On Korean-English and Korean-Japanese retrieval, the mean within-support selection component is the only one that exceeds its calibrated null band (+29.7 and +5.6 holdout items; 30/30 positive replicates), decisively in Korean-English and marginally in Korean-Japanese; redistribution and interaction remain unresolved at the available power. The same pattern holds for a second, unrelated gate family -- a model-confidence threshold rather than a deterministic verifier -- judged against its own null (+27.3 items, 9/9 positive), so the result is not a property of one gate's mechanism. On a mathematics gate, zero-eligibility supports leave the ordinary design undefined at every budget, while the extended design is constructible only inside narrow budget bands that an exhaustive scan locates and that the natural operating point misses -- the assembly condition separating a property of the pool from a limitation of the packer. CGSD therefore returns a decomposition, a constructible-but-underpowered design, or an explicit non-constructibility result, and says which; it prevents support redistribution from being silently interpreted as sample-level gate quality.
articles.titleCn: 反事实门控支持分解：在训练数据过滤中将选择与再分配分离
articles.abstractCn: 一个训练数据质量门控会改变哪些样本在输入空间的区域内存活，以及训练质量如何在这些区域间分布，因此门控与随机比较并不能分离这些机制。我们引入了反事实门控支持分解（CGSD），这是一种四臂、预算匹配的设计，它交叉了门控资格与支持分布，并将观察到的门控效应分解为支持内选择、支持间再分配及其相互作用。实际约束是有限池可实现性：我们描述了在何种质量和标记组装条件下所需臂可以构建，以及一个支持灭绝情况，其中普通设计未定义。在韩英和韩日检索中，支持内选择组件是唯一超过其校准空置带的（韩英+29.7，韩日+5.6个空置项；30/30阳性重复），在韩英中决定性，在韩日中边缘性；再分配和相互作用在现有功率下仍未解决。对于第二个、无关的门控家族——一个模型置信度阈值而非确定性验证器——与其自身空置带比较（+27.3项，9/9阳性），相同模式成立，因此结果不是某个门控机制的特性。在一个数学门控中，零资格支持在所有预算下使普通设计未定义，而扩展设计只能构建在窄预算带内，这些预算带需要通过穷举扫描定位而自然操作点会忽略——这是将池的特性与打包者的限制分开的组装条件。因此CGSD返回分解、一个可构建但功率不足的设计，或一个明确不可构建的结果，并说明是哪种；它防止支持再分配被无声地解释为样本级门控质量。

articles.title: LLM-jp-4 Technical Report
articles.abstract: This paper presents LLM-jp-4, a family of Japanese sovereign large language models (LLMs) developed with an emphasis on transparency, reproducibility, and practical usability. LLM-jp-4 comprises an 8B dense model and a 32B-A3B mixture-of-experts model, both trained from scratch on approximately 12 trillion tokens. To support independent verification and reproduction, we establish explicit criteria for selecting training data, external models, and software, and make the development process publicly available. Evaluation results demonstrate substantial improvements over previous LLM-jp models and competitive performance against open-weight models of similar scale. By documenting the development principles, training procedures, and empirical findings of LLM-jp-4, we aim to provide a reference for future sovereign AI development.
articles.comment: Results for the LLM-jp-4 33B dense model are not included in this version and will be added in a future revision
articles.titleCn: LLM-jp-4 技术报告
articles.abstractCn: 本文介绍了LLM-jp-4，这是一系列以透明性、可重复性和实用可用性为重点开发的日本主权大型语言模型（LLM）。LLM-jp-4包含一个8B密集模型和一个32B-A3B专家混合模型，两者均在约120万亿个token上从头开始训练。为了支持独立验证和可重复性，我们建立了明确的训练数据、外部模型和软件选择标准，并公开了开发过程。评估结果表明，与之前的LLM-jp模型相比有显著改进，并且在性能上与规模相似的开放权重模型具有竞争力。通过记录LLM-jp-4的开发原则、训练流程和实证发现，我们旨在为未来的主权AI发展提供参考。

articles.title: TopicMerge: A Divide and Conquer Approach to Topic Modeling
articles.abstract: Recent advancements in topic modeling have split into two main paths: efficient embedding-based methods that offer scalability but are often outperformed on standard clustering metrics, and Large Language Model (LLM) approaches that achieve state-of-the-art clustering performance but at the cost of prohibitive computational expense and poor scalability. This paper introduces TopicMerge, a novel multi-stage pipeline that bridges these approaches to achieve both state-of-the-art clustering performance and computational efficiency. TopicMerge first employs an efficient clustering pipeline to deliberately over-segment a document corpus into a large set of fine-grained, semantically pure micro-clusters, which are then given initial semantic labels. It then introduces a novel, iterative merging algorithm where an LLM, guided by local neighborhood context, arbitrates on consolidating candidate pairs. These approved merges are then selectively executed and semantically relabeled by the LLM, hierarchically building broader, more coherent topics. Extensive experiments on the Bills and Wiki datasets show that TopicMerge achieves state-of-the-art clustering performance while reducing required LLM calls by over 92% compared to document-level methods, offering a practical and scalable solution.
articles.titleCn: 主题合并：一种基于分治法的主题建模方法
articles.abstractCn: 近年来，主题建模技术发展分为两大主要路径：高效的基于嵌入的方法，虽然具有可扩展性，但在标准聚类指标上往往表现不佳；以及大型语言模型（LLM）方法，虽然实现了最先进的聚类性能，但代价是高昂的计算成本和较差的可扩展性。本文介绍了TopicMerge，一种新颖的多阶段流程，它连接了这些方法，以实现最先进的聚类性能和计算效率。TopicMerge首先采用高效的聚类流程，有意地将文档语料库过度分割成大量细粒度、语义纯净的微簇，然后为这些微簇赋予初始语义标签。接着，它引入了一种新颖的迭代合并算法，其中LLM在局部邻域上下文的指导下，对候选合并对进行仲裁。这些批准的合并随后被选择性地执行并由LLM进行语义重标，逐级构建更广泛、更连贯的主题。在Bills和Wiki数据集上的大量实验表明，TopicMerge实现了最先进的聚类性能，同时与文档级方法相比，将所需的LLM调用次数减少了92%以上，提供了一种实用且可扩展的解决方案。
